title: Strategic Account Executive - France
description:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

As a Strategic Enterprise Account Executive, you will drive Zip’s expansion into global enterprises with $7B+ in revenue. This is a high-impact, consultative sales role requiring deep industry expertise, a hunter mentality, and a passion for solving complex procurement challenges.

You Will

  • Own the full sales cycle: Engage C-level executives, influence stakeholders across procurement, finance, IT, legal, and operations, and navigate long, complex deal cycles.

  • Drive new business: While supported by BDRs and marketing, you’ll proactively prospect and leverage your network to develop a strong pipeline.

  • Act as a strategic advisor: Understand enterprise procurement challenges and position Zip as a transformational solution for efficiency and cost control.

  • Solution-sell with vision: Demonstrate Zip’s immediate impact while aligning with customers’ long-term digital transformation goals.

  • Shape the future: As an early sales leader in a hyper-growth startup, help refine Zip’s sales strategy, process, and team culture.

  • Leverage best-in-class sales tools: Utilize Salesforce, Clari, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Outreach to optimize outreach and pipeline management.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of SaaS sales experience, with a strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals.

  • Experience selling to procurement, finance, legal, IT, operations, supply chain, or manufacturing teams.

  • Proven success acquiring net-new logos in organizations with 10,000+ employees.

  • Skilled in complex sales cycles: Managing multiple stakeholders, navigating procurement processes, and driving consensus at the executive level.

  • Self-motivated and proactive: You take ownership of your success and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

  • Exceptional communication and organization skills to manage multiple opportunities effectively.

  • Fluent in French to a native speaker standard

Perks and Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

  • 📈 Start-up equity

  • 🦷 Health benefits

  • 🌴 Flexible PTO

  • 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

  • 💻 Work from home allowance

  • 🍼 Paid parental leave

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

Dayton, Ohio - 100% onsite

title: Hardware Expert (MSc. or PhD)
description:
Hardware Expert (MSc. or PhD)

Pay: $60–$120/hour

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible—you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

micro1 is engaging experienced Hardware Engineers to contribute to AI training projects built around complex, real-world engineering problems. In this role, you will use your technical expertise to create, solve, and evaluate engineering challenges that require sound judgment, quantitative reasoning, and reproducible answers.

We are looking for engineers who have personally owned meaningful technical work—such as taking a hardware system into production, validating a model against test data, developing a rigorous verification approach, or diagnosing a difficult failure. We value engineers who can connect first-principles reasoning with practical constraints and produce work that can be independently verified.

Scope of Work

  1. Create technically rigorous, self-contained hardware engineering problems based on realistic industry or research scenarios.
  2. Develop clear reference solutions using engineering calculations, simulations, scripts, experimental reasoning, or other appropriate methods.
  3. Use tools such as Python, MATLAB, Simulink, SPICE, Julia, C/C++, test automation platforms, or equivalent engineering software to validate results when relevant.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Applied Physics, or a closely related field.
  2. Significant professional or research experience in hardware engineering, product development, systems integration, testing, validation, reliability, or failure analysis.
  3. Demonstrated ownership of a substantial engineering problem—for example, a product or subsystem that reached production, a model validated against physical testing, a test system you developed, or a difficult failure you diagnosed.
  4. Experience working with Coding Agents is a must

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
description:
Job Title: Patient Care Advocate 

Job Location: Remote


About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview: 

As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. 


What You’ll Do: 

  • Patient Enrollment & Eligibility: Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. 
  • Prescription Coverage: Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. 
  • Cost-Sharing & Payment: Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. 
  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. 
  • Refills & Continued Use: Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. 
  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. 


What We’re Looking For: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes
  • Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies
  • A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access
  • The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment

Success Factors for Working from Home 

  • Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. 
  • Ergonomics: A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. 
  • Reliable Internet Connection: Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. 
  • Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace: A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. 
  • Tech-Savvy: Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. 
  • Self-motivation & Independence: Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. 
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. 
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. 


Compensation & Perks 

  • Hourly Pay: $16.50 per hour 
  • Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. 
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. 
  • Cell Phone Benefits: $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). 
  • Generous Referral Program: Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. 
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. 
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. 
  • Work-from-Home Convenience: Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. 
  • Inclusive Culture: We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. 

What Success Looks Like: 

  • Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance 
  • Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals 
  • High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience 
  • Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance 

Why Join Us? 

  • Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications 
  • Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors 
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package 
  • A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture 

Ready to Make an Impact? 

Join us in making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for those who need them most. If you're ready to help make a difference, we'd love to hear from you! 

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.


About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Why This Role Exists

As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet.

You'll own technical solution design and deployment readiness, translating customer requirements into secure, scalable deployment architectures. You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production.

Youâll work with our go-to-market and customer facing teams to meet with planners, operations officers, and network owners to understand how they work today. Youâll help show them what that work looks like in Onebrief, and then you'll make it real.

You connect a staff's planning problem to a live, accredited Onebrief deployment.

What You'll Do

Core responsibilities:

  • Run technical discovery. With Sales and Engineering, map a staff's current workflow and pain points, specifically focusing on their technical constraints: networks, hosting, identity, and integration requirements, especially in multi-network environments.

  • Lead deployment engineering. Coordinate the technical delivery of new deployments, including infrastructure validation, network configuration checks, and system readiness verification. Write code to configure new deployments and support new environments.

  • Support accreditation. Help create and review security documentation, including STIG checklists and ATO artifacts, alongside our cybersecurity team so deployments are accredited on the customer's timeline.

  • Align stakeholders. Get technical stakeholders on both sides to agree on requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs, so customers see value sooner. Ensure those technical requirements are properly translated into contract deliverables.

  • Scope integrations. Design how Onebrief Connect fits into a command's ecosystem: APIs, data pipelines, Foundry and Maven Smart System, CUOPS tools, and dashboards.

  • Deliver tailored demos. Lead technical demonstrations and solution validation, partnering with Sales and customer-facing teams to demonstrate Onebrief's technical capabilities, deployment architecture, security posture, and integration options.

  • Run pilot deployments. Configure Onebrief in new and untested environments to enable limited uses in support of new sales.

  • Turn field experience into patterns. Convert what you learn in deployments into structured workflows and reusable implementation patterns, and feed clear requirements to Product and Engineering.

  • Travel 30â50% of the time to customer sites and exercises.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 4+ years in solutions engineering, infrastructure or deployment engineering, or forward-deployed engineering, working closely with go-to-market and operational teams

  • Experience in DoW environments and their security and compliance requirements (RMF, STIGs, ICD 503)

  • Strong expertise with containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and on-premises virtualization (RHEL)

  • Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, and of security best practices for highly sensitive environments

  • Strong presence with customers, from action officers to senior leaders, and clear, concise writing

  • Calm under pressure, and focused on forward motion

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in a scripting language (Python, Go, or Bash)

  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible)

  • Monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog) and service mesh (Istio, Linkerd)

  • Experience as a military planner or staff officer, or with mission command systems, Foundry, or Maven Smart System

  • Presales experience, including building and delivering demos


Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies
Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.

title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), RFA
description:
About RFA and Titan

RFA is a leading IT and cybersecurity partner to financial services firms: hedge funds, private equity, asset managers, and the firms that serve them. RFA is part of Titan, which is building the AI workforce for IT.

Titan has raised over $100M from General Catalyst, 8VC, and CalPERS, acquired market-leading IT firms like RFA, and put AI agents into production in large enterprises. We've automated 100K+ tickets across 800+ customers and are leading the industry in service quality. Our tech team has talent from Scale AI, CoreWeave, Vanta, Dropbox, Meta, FiveRings, TwoSigma, Amazon, Harvard, Stanford, and MIT.

Why this role, why now

AI is changing security faster than anything we've seen, and we want RFA to be the one leading it for its clients. RFA's clients answer to regulators, investors, and DDQs, and they expect their IT partner to be the most security-minded team in the room. With Titan's AI agents now working alongside RFA's engineers, we can deliver security that is faster, more thorough, and more proactive than a traditional MSP or MSSP.

We're looking for a CISO for RFA: a security leader who wants to build security for financial firms from the ground up, with AI at the center of how it's delivered.

About the role

As RFA's CISO, you own security for RFA and its clients. You lead RFA's GRC, SOC, and vCISO teams, act as the senior security advisor to client leadership, and make sure RFA itself holds up to the scrutiny of the most demanding funds. You'll report to RFA's COO and work closely with RFA's service delivery and engineering teams, and with Titan's product and engineering teams.

You own and measure success by client outcomes (incidents prevented and contained, audits and DDQs passed), growth and retention of RFA's security revenue, and an RFA that passes every client security review.

This role is remote (US).

In this role you will

  • Set RFA's security strategy and lead RFA's GRC, SOC, and vCISO teams, who report to you

  • Build and run RFA's client security offering: vCISO, managed detection and response, SOC, vulnerability management, email security, and incident response, with AI agents doing the volume and people doing the judgment

  • Be the trusted security advisor to client CFOs, COOs, and CCOs: board and investment committee updates, regulatory readiness (SEC, FINRA, Reg S-P, state privacy rules), and investor DDQs

  • Lead incident response for RFA clients, from first alert to client communication and lessons learned

  • Own RFA's own security and compliance program, including SOC 2 and the security questionnaires clients send us

  • Work with Titan's engineers to make sure the AI agents working in client environments are safe: least-privilege access, guardrails, logging, and audit trails

  • Guide RFA clients adopting Claude, ChatGPT, and Copilot on AI governance: data boundaries, connector and permission review, shadow AI discovery

  • Join sales cycles as RFA's security voice: win the client's CISO or CCO, and turn what we learn into packaged services and pricing

You might thrive in this role if you

  • Bring 10+ years in security, including leading a security function or practice as CISO, VP, or Head of Security

  • Have built or run security services at an MSP, MSSP, or security consultancy, ideally serving financial services firms

  • Know what hedge funds, PE firms, and asset managers need from security: SEC cybersecurity rules, Reg S-P, investor DDQs, and frameworks like NIST CSF, SOC 2, and ISO 27001

  • Are hands-on with Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Defender, and modern EDR, SIEM, and email security stacks

  • Are excited, not threatened, by AI agents doing security work, and have opinions on how to make them safe

  • Can explain risk to a fund COO in plain language and to an engineer in technical detail

  • Take extreme ownership and would rather build the program than inherit one

Bonus

  • CISSP, CISM, CISA, or CRISC

  • vCISO experience across multiple financial services clients

  • Experience securing LLM applications or AI governance work (e.g., ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF)

Logistics

Location: Remote (US)

Travel: Under 5%, for occasional client meetings and time with the team in NYC

title: Detection & Response Engineer
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Detection and Response

The Detection and Response team is responsible for detection engineering, threat intelligence, and incident response across Nebius Cloud. Its goal is to improve and maintain Nebius's security monitoring capabilities, as well as to build and maintain an end-to-end Security Incident Response program - people, processes, and tools.

The Role

We're hiring a Detection & Response Engineer to build and run our D&R capability from the ground up. You'll work on detection engineering, threat intelligence, and incident response functions across Nebius Cloud.

You'll be responsible for detection development, handling complex security incidents, forensics, and shaping the D&R strategy.

What you’ll do

  • Detection development: maintain low false-positive and false-negative rates. Work closely with alerts consumers (20+ teams) to keep noise low and signal high, ensuring they can act quickly without missing genuine threats.
  • Architect and operate detection coverage across our cloud and bare-metal environments
  • Build and extend our internal D&R tools and pipelines - onboard new logs, build and automate response runbooks.
  • Integrate threat intelligence into detection logic and IR playbooks, tracking adversary TTPs relevant to Cloud infrastructure
  • Lead incident response end-to-end: scoping, containment, root cause analysis, post-incident reviews and controlling critical action items are closed to prevent future possible incidents.
  • Partner with Compliance and Engineering teams to detect real threats while meeting the needs of both engineers and regulators.
  • Define and report on D&R metrics: MTTD, MTTR, detection coverage, false positive rates, etc.
  • Build and maintain Security Incident Response program: people, processes, tools.
  • Build tools, runbooks, and on-call processes that scale as the company grows.

What we look for

  • 6+ years in security operations, detection engineering, or incident response.
  • Deep hands-on experience with cloud-native environments (Kubernetes, Linux workloads, container-based infrastructure).
  • Strong detection engineering skills: writing and tuning rules/detections in SIEM platforms (e.g., Chronicle, Splunk, Elastic) and SQL.
  • Experience building or operating SOAR workflows and automating response at scale (ideally with Golang and Temporal).
  • Working knowledge of threat intelligence frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK, Pyramid of Pain, Kill Chain) and how to operationalize them in detections.
  • Solid IR fundamentals: memory forensics, log analysis, network traffic analysis, and post-incident reporting.
  • Stakeholder management: able to coordinate across engineers, compliance, legal, executives during active incident phase. Serve as the primary owner and driver for complex changes, as a result of incidents post-mortem.

Nice to have

  • Experience with AI/ML and GPU clusters related threats.
  • Familiarity with eBPF-based detection or runtime security tooling (Falco, Tetragon).
  • Background in threat hunting.

Why this role at Nebius

  • Build D&R at a company scaling from startup to global infrastructure provider in real time.
  • Ability to evolve our internal D&R platform into a new cloud security product, delivering novel security observability for a range of neocloud customers - from big tech to AI startups.
  • Work alongside world-class engineers on infrastructure that powers frontier AI.
  • Competitive compensation with equity upside in a Nasdaq-listed, high-growth company.
  • Flexible, remote-first culture.

Hiring Process

  • Recruiter's chat (30mins)
  • Live-coding interview (60mins) to asses basic coding skills
  • Security interview (60mins) to asses domain expertise
  • Incident Response interview (90mins) to assess practical experience
  • Final interview to close the hiring process (45mins)

#LI-CP1

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

title: AWS Cloud Solutions Architect
description:
As a Senior AWS Cloud Solutions Architect, you will be the technical lead on our most complex engagements, from assessment and mobilization to large-scale migration and modernization. You will report to an Engineering Manager based in Europe and lead distributed teams of US- and Budapest-based engineers. You will also work closely with colleagues in our AI/ML and Application Development practices.



What you'll be doing:

  • Lead the technical delivery of complex, high-impact migration and modernization engagements, including AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) assessments and mobilization.

  • Lead technical discovery and design multi-service, cloud-native AWS architectures that turn business goals into scalable blueprints.

  • Technically lead teams of 1â4 engineers, and manage the technical roadmap of 2â3 engagements in parallel.

  • Own technical design decisions within project scope. Resolve technical disagreements and handle scope conversations with clients professionally.

  • Represent Client in customers sessions, including executive-level conversations and joint sessions with AWS stakeholders.

  • Spend around 25% of your time on pre-sales: discovery, solution design and co-selling with AWS account teams in North America.

  • Resolve high-risk technical blockers and escalations, including critical production incidents.

  • Adapt to changing delivery expectations and keep engagements on track under uncertainty.

  • Build architectural guardrails, reusable frameworks and components that raise quality across the practice.

  • Coach engineers and share knowledge through internal sessions, workshops, whitepapers and technical evangelism.

  • Be the go-to expert in one or more domains, such as MSSQL Server, PostgreSQL, EKS, VMware, data, security or networking.

  • Help shape our technical offerings and accelerators in line with market and AWS trends.



What you bring:

  • 8+ years in infrastructure or cloud engineering, including 5+ years designing and delivering on AWS.

  • A proven track record of leading at least two large-scale cloud migrations end to end.

  • Hands-on database migration experience with MSSQL Server, Oracle or PostgreSQL.

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect â Professional.

  • In-depth knowledge of core AWS services, including:

    • Compute and containers: EC2, Lambda, ECS, EKS

    • Storage and databases: S3, RDS, EFS, EBS

    • Networking and integration: VPC, API Gateway, CloudFront, SNS, SQS

    • Security: IAM, Security Hub, GuardDuty, KMS, AWS Private CA

    • Operations and migration: CloudWatch, AWS Application Migration Service

  • Strong Infrastructure as Code skills. Terraform is preferred; CloudFormation, AWS CDK or Ansible are also welcome.

  • Hands-on experience building and running CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, GitLab, Bitbucket or similar.

  • Experience running containerized workloads with Docker and Kubernetes or EKS.

  • Strong networking knowledge: TCP/IP, DNS, load balancers, firewalls and VPN, plus AWS networking services such as VPC, Route 53, ELB and CloudFront.

  • Strong security knowledge: IAM, least privilege, access control, endpoint security and data encryption.

  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills. You are confident with executives and engineering teams alike.

  • Comfort working in a distributed team, with a few hours of daily overlap with Central European Time.

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.


Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with AWS MAP phases: Assess, Mobilize, and Migrate & Modernize.

  • Migrations from VMware, on-premises data centers, Azure or GCP.

  • Experience with AI-assisted migration and modernization tooling, such as AWS Transform.

  • AWS Specialty certifications, such as Security or Advanced Networking.

Final Details

Remote

title: Inside Sales Contractor
description:
About Us

We are a financial services start up focusing on helping to improve consumer credit profiles. We are currently seeking KPI driven sales representatives looking to earn up to 45K in their first year while working remotely. We offer comprehensive training and continuous sales coaching to help you meet your financial goals.

During our training period we offer a guaranteed training stipend while our trainees are acclimating to the position (*see weekly pay below). If you are a seasoned sales professional looking for the autonomy of a remote position combined with great compensation, we want to hear from you!

Compensation Structure

This role is 100% commission-based, which means your earning potential is unlimited. In addition, we regularly offer competitive performance-based bonuses to reward hard work and results.

Training Period (Weeks 1–4)

We invest in your success and want to make sure you’re supported as you get up to speed:

  • Week 1: Commission-only (a chance to start earning right away while learning the ropes).

  • Weeks 2–4: Guaranteed training stipend of $500 USD total – or your commission if it’s higher. You’ll always receive whichever amount benefits you most.

    • Week 0: Unpaid

    • Week 1: $100 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 2: $150 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 3: $250 guaranteed minimum

By the end of training, you’ll have the skills to maximize commissions, with the safety net of a guaranteed base during your ramp-up period.

Post Training Period:

  • Average first year OTE: 25K-35K (US) Annually

  • Top Rep first year OTE: 35K-45K (US) Annually

*The above is the average pay you can expect, however, there is unlimited earning potential for those who are financially motivated top performers looking to exceed sales targets.

What will you be doing?

Educating inbound callers on their credit standing by providing consultations with the goal of enrolling them in one of our services should they be a good fit.

We are looking for team members who are:

  • Tech savvy with the ability to navigate digital tools such as SLACK, CRM software, google sheets, etc. Our team uses these digital tools daily.

  • Growth oriented and always looking to learn and acquire new skills.

  • Autonomous self starters who can work independently and efficiently.

  • Team players with the ability to implement feedback from their sales coaches.

  • Patient and professional with clients. Finances can be a difficult topic for some clients to discuss. We are looking for individuals who showcase empathy and professionalism especially under pressure!

  • Financially motivated individuals who can meet and exceed sales targets.

  • Outgoing with outstanding rapport building and active listening skills. Can you carry a conversation with anyone? This may be for you!

You will need:

  • Home office or a quiet place to work.

  • Strong internet connection.

  • Desktop or laptop

(*Please Note: Devices such as Chromebooks, IPADs and laptops with 8G’s of RAM and under will have issues supporting our system)

Scheduling

Training: The schedule for the first four weeks of our training period is 10 AM - 6 PM EST.

*The first week of training is mandatory for all new trainees. If a day is missed you may be asked to restart the first week of training.

Post Training:

We are currently seeking representatives to work on the following schedule:

Monday - Friday

Shift hours to be discussed with our hiring manager based on our company's needs at the time of hire. Shifts are as follows:

title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
description:
Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

 

We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.

 

Duties

 

·       Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients

 

·       Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success

 

·       Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required

 

·       Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.

 

·       Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines

 

·       Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues

 

·       Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management

 

·       Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment

 

·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

 

·       Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives

 

Our Technology Stack

 

·       Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA

 

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

 

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

 

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

 

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

 

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

 

Client Driven Results

 

Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.

 

Own Your Progress

 

We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes.  Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution.

 

We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

We are specifically looking for coaches who have experience in Singapore or Hong Kong serving the SEA region, or experience in market including Japan, India, South Korea, and Australia.

As a Mento coach, you will form 1:1 partnerships with our members to help them identify & track clear goals, become a better leader, communicate more effectively, problem solve issues at work, and help them feel happy, fulfilled, and engaged at work and beyond.

All Mento coaches, regardless of coaching experience, are required to participate in our ICF-certified coach training program to learn Mentoâs coaching methodology prior to working with our members. Our coach training is an immersive, transformational training designed to help you grow as a coach, master the Mento Coaching Methodology, and gain access to proprietary tools that set our coaches apart. This program is ICF-certified, and participants who successfully graduate will earn Continuing Coach Education Units. If youâre ready to elevate your coaching skills, deepen your impact, and become part of a groundbreaking coaching team, we encourage you to apply and take the next step in your journey!

Your routine responsibilities will include:

  • Providing 1:1 coaching to Mento members through virtual sessions using the Mento Platform and Tools

  • Participating in ongoing training sessions to improve coaching abilities and skills

  • Communicating with members via your Mento email or via chat in the Mento App in between sessions

  • Being an integral member of the Mento coaching community by sharing coaching tools and insights â helping enhance our coaching practices and fulfill our mission of empowering people to thrive in jobs that they love

  • Acting with kindness, respect, and empathy as an ambassador of the Mento community

Who are you?

You areâ¦

  • A director, vice president, or other senior strategy & operations leader with 20+ years experience managing strategy & ops teams and coaching individuals (coaching certification is a plus but not required).

  • Someone who wants to turn their people leadership skills into meaningful coaching skills.

  • Passionate about helping people advance in the workplace to build fulfilling careers and lives.

  • A person who is self aware, who has a high emotional IQ, and who cares about creating a safe space for others to risk being vulnerable.

  • Excited about growing your coaching skills, and you bring a growth-mindset to the experience, regardless of how long you have been a coach.

  • Comfortable working in a constantly-changing startup environment.

  • Able to dedicate a minimum of 12+ hours per month to coaching at Mento for the next 24+ months.

At Mento, we invite new coaches to join us on a rolling basis. The time frame on which we add new coaches is based on the particular needs of our clients and their teams. While we may not need to add an Operations & Strategy VP Coach today, we would still be very excited for you to get in touch with us now if this opportunity resonates with you.

Other details

  • This is a contract position in which coaches are paid per hour. On top of a flat hourly rate, we offer select bonuses that incentivizes engagement with our membership and community growth on our platform

  • You must have the capacity to give a minimum of three to five hours per week towards Mento regardless of other commitments and how they may change.

  • You are able to work with Mento for a minimum of 24 months in order to build meaningful relationships with our members.

  • This is a fully remote position. Candidates must be based in North America or Europe.

  • Because this is a part-time growth opportunity, we are looking to hire experienced senior leaders who want to expand their coaching skills.

Our Hiring Philosophy:
All new Mento coaches are required to participate and graduate from our ICF certified coach training program: Mento Coaching 101. This training is rigorous, and our goal is that all participants are able to be matched with members soon after they complete it. We want to make sure that we are both setting our coaches up for success and respecting everyoneâs time. Therefore, we hire based on incoming member demand. While we are constantly looking and interviewing for the best coaches to join our team, we will only send offers to candidates for whom we have an immediate need. Candidates who receive a YES from Mento after the interview process will either be sent an offer to join the next monthly Coaching 101 training or be added to our coach shortlist to join us when the demand is there.

Inclusion Statement:
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Research shows that candidates from unrepresented backgrounds may not apply to jobs unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product for our users. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the requirements.

Caringhand Home Health Solutions, Inc. is committed to providing professional nursing and healthcare services that help patients achieve the highest possible level of independence in their daily activities. We strive to deliver high-quality home health care through comprehensive patient assessments, individualized care planning, and collaboration among healthcare professionals, patients, and families.

We are seeking a compassionate and dedicated Registered Nurse (RN) to provide skilled nursing care to patients in their homes and communities. The RN will assess patient and family needs, develop and implement individualized care plans, administer prescribed medications and treatments, educate patients and caregivers, and coordinate care with physicians and other healthcare professionals.

The successful candidate will demonstrate strong clinical judgment, excellent communication and problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently. This role also involves discharge planning, case management when assigned, and supervising and evaluating home health aide services to support safe, coordinated, and effective patient care.

If you are passionate about helping patients maintain their independence and well-being at home, we encourage you to join our team.

Note: This is a field-based, per diem position that requires travel to patientsâ homes. Although listed as âremote,â this is not a work-from-home or telehealth role.

Responsibilities
    • Conduct initial patient and family assessments to determine home health care needs, including physical assessments and histories of current and previous illnesses.
    • Regularly reassess patientsâ nursing needs and evaluate changes in their conditions.
    • Initiate and revise individualized plans of care as patient status and needs change.
    • Use assessment findings to establish nursing diagnoses and develop appropriate care plans.
    • Develop care plans that establish patient-centered goals and incorporate therapeutic, preventive, and rehabilitative nursing interventions.
    • Involve patients and their families in care planning and decision-making.
    • Administer medications and treatments as prescribed by the physician.
    • Implement appropriate preventive and rehabilitative nursing procedures.
    • Counsel patients and families regarding nursing and related healthcare needs.
    • Provide patient and caregiver education based on assessments and the established plan of care.
    • Identify discharge planning needs during care planning and implement appropriate arrangements before patient discharge.
    • Serve as case manager when assigned by the Clinical Supervisor or Nursing Supervisor, coordinating care for the assigned patient caseload.
    • Prepare accurate clinical notes and update the primary physician as needed and at least every 60 days.
    • Communicate patient needs and changes in condition to physicians, and obtain or receive physician orders as required.
    • Coordinate with community healthcare professionals and other relevant parties to support the patient's plan of care.
    • Participate in on-call duties according to organizational policy.
    • Ensure arrangements for necessary equipment, supplies, and other patient services.
    • Instruct, supervise, and evaluate home health aide services provided to patients every two weeks.
    • Perform other related duties as assigned to support patient care.
    • Graduate of an accredited school of nursing.
    • Current, active Registered Nurse (RN) license in California.
    • At least 1â2 years of recent acute care experience in an institutional setting.
    • Current CPR certification.
    • Valid driver's license and access to a reliable vehicle insured in accordance with state and organizational requirements.
    • Excellent observation and clinical assessment skills.
    • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
    • Effective problem-solving skills and basic mathematical skills.
    • Ability to perform nursing duties according to established competency requirements.
    • Ability to work independently and coordinate patient care responsibilities.
    • Ability to perform the physical duties associated with patient care, including prolonged standing or walking, lifting supplies and equipment, and assisting with patient positioning or transfers, with applicable accommodations.

Preferred Qualifications

    • Bachelor's degree in nursing.

Additional role responsibility: The RN is responsible for supervising home health aides. Previous management experience is not required.

At NaroIQ, we believe the fund industry is undergoing a structural shift: investors are more cost-conscious and transparency-driven than ever, and ETFs are a natural outcome of this shift.

Yet many capital management companies (ManCos) excel at running traditional mutual funds - but struggle to enter the ETF market. Launching and operating ETFs adds a new layer of complexity: new partners, interfaces, processes, and systems that most existing setups weren't built for.

NaroIQ gives ManCos a fast, reliable path into the ETF market. We provide the digital ETF infrastructure that reduces operational complexity, so ManCos can launch and run ETFs at scale and compete effectively, helping broaden access to the market beyond dominant, US-based providers.

We are remote-first, with in-person collaboration opportunities. We work with international clients and have raised over $10m from top-tier investors and operators across finance and technology.

The Role and What Makes It Special

You own the two functions that decide how the outside world experiences NaroIQ: How we are perceived in the market, and who we manage to attract to build it. Marketing and Employer Branding sit together in one role at NaroIQ because the same narrative - sharp, technical, high quality - has to land with senior executives and journalists as well as with the engineers, operators and commercial talent we want to hire next.

This is a hands-on, individual contributor role. You will not manage a team of specialists who do the work - you'll do the work: drafting the LinkedIn post, creating our brand strategy, building relationships with journalists, organizing events, designing an employer brand. And you'll build the systems that let NaroIQ scale this without losing sharpness.

There is no marketing playbook to inherit and nobody above you in the function. You set the priorities, decide what not to do, and carry the call. That takes unusual self-drive - the kind where nobody has to ask you for a status update, and where an unclear brief is something you resolve rather than escalate.

You report to the CEO (Chris) and work in tight loops with Growth, Product and the leadership team. Over time, you have the opportunity to grow the function around you.

Tasks

What You'll Do

PR & Events

  • Run PR campaigns end-to-end, directly and with external PR partners, to build durable credibility and secure consistent placements in tier-1 outlets (Handelsblatt, Bloomberg, FT) and the FinTech and asset-management publications that matter
  • Build and maintain a working network of journalists and editors; develop narratives that sharpen NaroIQ's positioning
  • Plan and coordinate events and speaking slots (e.g. Money20/20, FinTech and asset-management conferences, exclusive industry roundtables)

Content & Brand

  • Build a scalable content and thought-leadership engine that actively supports sales enablement and pipeline progression
  • Grow NaroIQ's organic LinkedIn presence at the company and founder level. A steady cadence of substantive posts, not noise.
  • Build and maintain a consistent brand identity across every surface: website, pitch deck, one-pagers, careers page, sales collateral
  • Create a brand that sticks with our audience: You decide how we are perceived in the market and what the NaroIQ storyline should look like

Demand Generation & Sales Alignment

  • Develop the materials that prepare and accelerate enterprise conversations: one-pagers, decks, whitepapers, case studies
  • Build and run inbound growth motions: SEO, AI search optimization, and targeted growth experiments
  • Close the loop with Sales: instrument what's working, kill what isn't, feed campaign learnings back into product and positioning

Employer Branding

  • Build NaroIQ's employer brand into a real asset: a careers narrative that pulls senior talent in, a candidate experience that earns referrals
  • Position NaroIQ as one of the most attractive places to work in European FinTech; through content, events, founder presence, and glimpses into the lived experience of the team

Requirements

What We're Looking For

(You don't need to know it all - but you should be ready to dive in, learn fast, and take initiative.)

  • Experience in B2B marketing: Ideally in financial services or at an AI / enterprise startup
  • You can create a brand, not just run one: you've built positioning and narrative for a product or category, ideally while the product was still moving
  • Creative and strong at storytelling: You can draft an explanatory case study, a press pitch that lands, and a job description that pulls. Without slipping into FinTech buzzwords
  • Extroverted and a strong communicator: You build real relationships with journalists, candidates and event coordinators
  • Existing PR network or demonstrable track record in media work is a big plus
  • Data-driven: You think in KPIs and processes, and use them to make the work sharper
  • Experimental: You actively try new channels and formats, like AI search, new social formats, distribution plays
  • You treat candidates as an audience: you can write a role description that makes people apply, shape how NaroIQ shows up to talent, and equip hiring managers with a story worth telling
  • A taste-led approach to brand: you can hold a consistent visual and verbal system across surfaces and push back on output that breaks it
  • Structured and genuinely self-directed: you're comfortable operating with ambiguity, high ownership and no cover in a small, fast-moving team
  • Fluent in English and German, written and spoken

Nice to have: existing relationships with FinTech or asset-management journalists; experience building a careers brand from scratch; familiarity with growth tooling (SEO, attribution, growth-hacking stacks).

Why NaroIQ

We're building something ambitious - and we believe the only way to do that is with a team that's low-ego, high-impact, and genuinely excited about what they're doing.

Here's what we care about:

🔑 High Ownership
We trust you to take full responsibility for your work. That means freedom and also being the person others rely on when things get real.

🚫 No Bullshit, No Ego
We're too small for politics, posturing or competing agendas. We care about doing the right thing, not being right.

🧘‍♂️ Flexibility
Exceptional work doesn't require relocation or fixed office hours. Have dinner with your family. Get that dog. Move to the Alps. We're remote-first and trust people to manage their own time.

🧳 Sometimes We Leave the House
We do make time for real-life moments, like quarterly offsites or in-person team sessions, to solve stuff together or just hang out.

🦸🏻‍♀️ Hire for Spikes
We don't expect you to be good at everything. We care about your superpower. We're building a team of nerds who are world-class in wildly different areas.

🛠 Default to Rethink
We don't accept "that's just how it is." We dig deep, think from scratch and always believe there's a better way. First Principles isn't a buzzword for us.

💅🏼 Give Yourself a Little Treat
We offer benefits via hrmony, so you can spend up to €50/month on the little things that bring you joy: Urban Sports, DAZN, Mediamarkt, Thalia, whatever suits you.

🤓 Your Learning Curve is Our Investment
Everyone at NaroIQ gets €1,000 per year for courses, books, coaching, or whatever helps them grow.

title: Technical Sales Specialist (m/w/d) ProSys DACH
description:
Über uns

Wir sind einer der weltweit führenden Premiumanbieter messtechnischer Systeme. Unter der Marke Gossen Metrawatt entwickeln und vertreiben wir hochwertige Mess- und Prüftechnik für das Elektrohandwerk, die Industrie und für öffentliche Einrichtungen. Gossen Metrawatt steht seit Jahrzehnten als Synonym für Sicherheit und Qualität Made in Germany. Das Produktportfolio umfasst Mess- und Prüftechnik für die elektrische Sicherheit in Anlagen und Geräten sowie im Bereich E-Mobility und Medizintechnik. Power Quality, Energiemanagementsysteme, digitale Dienste und Cloud-Services sowie unsere After-Sales-Dienstleistungen sind weitere wichtige Bereiche.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Identifizierung und Priorisierung neuer Geschäftschancen für das Produktportfolie von ProSys Ltd. in der DACH-Region, zunächst mit Schwerpunkt auf den §14a-EnWG-Märkten

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Gebiets- und Geschäftsentwicklungsplänen zur Erreichung der Umsatz-, Margen- und Wachstumsziele

  • Beobachtung von Markttrends, Wettbewerb, Regulatorik und Kundenbedürfnissen

  • Aufbau und Pflege nachhaltiger Beziehungen zu Kunden, Vertriebspartnern und weiteren Stakeholdern sowie Vertretung des Unternehmens bei Kundenterminen, Messen und Branchenveranstaltungen

  • Analyse von Kundenanforderungen und Entwicklung passender Lösungen, um Kundenbindung, Umsatz und Share of Wallet zu steigern

  • Aufbau und Steuerung einer qualifizierten Opportunity-Pipeline vom Erstkontakt bis zur Auftragsübergabe, einschließlich sorgfältiger CRM-Pflege und Forecasts

  • Koordination technischer und kaufmännischer Angebote sowie Führung von Vertragsverhandlungen im Rahmen der eigenen Entscheidungsbefugnisse

  • Verantwortung für Umsatz-, Margen- und Pipelineziele im eigenen Gebiet sowie regelmäßiges Reporting an den Business Development Director und die Geschäftsleitung

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Vertrieb, Marketing, Technik, Operations und Geschäftsleitung, inklusive Weitergabe von Kunden- und Marktwissen an Produktentwicklung und Marketing

Ihre fachliche Qualifikation

  • Hochschulabschluss, technische Qualifikation oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung in den Bereichen Elektrotechnik, Elektronik, Automatisierung, Energietechnik oder einem verwandten ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Fachgebiet

  • Erfahrung im technischen B2B-Vertrieb, in der Geschäftsentwicklung oder im Key-Account-Management in einem Umfeld der Ingenieur-, Elektro- oder Industrietechnik; entsprechende Erfahrung in der elektrischen Messtechnik, Strommessung, Test- und Messtechnik, industrielle Automatisierung oder Energiemanagement wünschenswert

  • Kenntnisse in Preisgestaltung, Margenmanagement, Prognosen, Angebotserstellung, Verhandlungsführung, Vertragsgestaltung

  • Professionelle Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (Fähigkeit zur Verhandlungsführung und geschäftlichen Korrespondenz in beiden Sprachen), Kenntnisse in einer weiteren europäischen Sprache von Vorteil

  • Fähigkeit, Kundenanwendungen und technische Anforderungen zu verstehen und diese in klare, wirtschaftlich überzeugende Lösungen und Wertversprechen umzusetzen

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in den Bereichen beratungsorientierter Vertrieb, Opportunity-Qualifizierung, Account-Planung, Pipeline-Management und komplexe Vertriebszyklen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, Microsoft Excel und Tools zur Vertriebsberichterstattung sowie die Fähigkeit, Daten zu analysieren und präzise Prognosen zu erstellen

  • PKW-Führerschein

Darum sind Sie persönlich unsere erste Wahl

  • Mit kaufmännischem Gespür und als selbstbewusster Kommunikator und Beziehungsbauer interagieren Sie effektiv mit Ingenieuren, Beschaffungsteams, Händlern, leitenden Entscheidungsträgern und anderen Stakeholdern.

  • Ihr Arbeitsstil ist strukturiert, eigenmotiviert und ergebnisorientiert, und Sie punkten durch Ihre ausgeprägten Fähigkeiten in den Bereichen Gebietsplanung, Priorisierung und Zeitmanagement.

  • Sie sind zu regelmäßigen Dienstreisen in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz sowie zu gelegentlichen Reisen nach Großbritannien und an andere internationale Standorte bereit.

Ihre Benefits

  • Sie erhalten einen Firmenlaptop, eine Home-Office-Ausstattung sowie ein Firmenhandy und einen Firmenwagen.

  • Profitieren Sie von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und der Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice

  • Für Ihre Absicherung sorgen eine private Krankenversicherung und eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge.

  • Reisekosten werden entsprechend entschädigt.

  • Zusätzlich stehen Ihnen 30 Urlaubstage im Jahr zur Verfügung.

title: Vertriebsmitarbeiter IT-Infrastruktur (m/w/d)
description:
Du redest gern mit Menschen, greifst lieber zum Hörer, als eine dritte E-Mail zu schreiben, und willst einen Kunden vom ersten Anruf bis zur Unterschrift selbst begleiten? Du willst nicht irgendetwas verkaufen, sondern eine IT, die danach wirklich läuft? Dann passt du zu uns.

Ob Berufseinsteiger oder erfahrener Vertriebler: Wichtiger als die Zahl deiner Berufsjahre ist uns, dass du zuhörst, dranbleibst und ehrlich berätst. Du musst kein Techniker sein. Was hinter Servern, Netzwerken und Cloud steckt, lernst du bei uns, mit Technikern, die bei Terminen an deiner Seite sind.

Wir sind MintCode Solutions aus Haselünne, ein Team aus 8 Leuten, das IT-Infrastruktur für Unternehmen in der Region baut und betreibt.

Aufgaben

  • Du erschließt dein eigenes Kundengebiet und bist dafür verantwortlich.

  • Du betreust deine Kunden vollständig selbst, von der Kaltakquise bis zur finalen Unterschrift: Es gibt keine Übergabe an einen anderen Vertriebler

  • Du verkaufst unsere gesamte IT-Infrastruktur: Server, Netzwerke, Cloud in deutschen Rechenzentren, Microsoft 365 und laufende Betreuung

  • Du planst selbst, welche Unternehmen du in deinem Gebiet ansprichst, und gehst aktiv auf sie zu, per Telefon, über LinkedIn, auf Veranstaltungen und über dein Netzwerk

  • Du führst Erstgespräche, online und vor Ort, verstehst, wo beim Kunden der Schuh drückt, und nimmst den Bedarf sauber auf

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Technikern die passende Lösung und erstellst das Angebot

  • Du fasst nach, verhandelst und holst die Unterschrift

  • Du bleibst auch nach dem Auftrag der Ansprechpartner deiner Kunden und baust dein Gebiet Schritt für Schritt aus

  • Du pflegst deine Kontakte und Gespräche so, dass jeder im Team den Stand nachvollziehen kann

  • Du bringst zurück ins Team, was Kunden fragen und brauchen, und redest bei unserem Angebot mit

Du baust den Vertrieb bei uns mit auf und hast entsprechend viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Und du stehst nicht allein da: Bei technischen Fragen ist immer ein Kollege da, der mit in den Termin kommt oder mit dir draufschaut.

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit:

  • Eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische oder technische Ausbildung, ein Studium oder vergleichbare Praxis, Quereinsteiger sind willkommen

  • Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu und telefonierst gern, auch mit Leuten, die dich noch nicht kennen

  • Du hörst zu, fragst nach und erklärst Dinge so, dass sie beim Gegenüber ankommen

  • Du bleibst dran, auch wenn es beim ersten und zweiten Anruf noch kein Ja gibt

  • Du führst Gespräche zu einem Ergebnis und scheust dich nicht, nach dem Auftrag zu fragen

  • Du interessierst dich für IT und hast Lust, dich in technische Themen einzuarbeiten

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und hältst, was du Kunden zusagst

  • Du sagst offen, was du denkst, auch gegenüber Kunden, wenn eine Lösung nicht zu ihnen passt

  • Führerschein Klasse B und Reisebereitschaft, weil du regelmäßig bei Kunden vor Ort bist

Schön, wenn du das schon kannst (sonst lernst du es bei uns):

  • Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, idealerweise in einem IT-Systemhaus oder bei einem IT-Dienstleister

  • Erfahrung mit Angeboten, Verhandlungen und Abschlüssen

  • Grundwissen zu Servern, Netzwerken, Cloud oder Microsoft 365

  • Erfahrung mit einem CRM-System

  • Ein Netzwerk zu Unternehmen in der Region

Für uns zählen Persönlichkeit, Motivation und Potenzial mehr als ein perfekter Lebenslauf. Wichtig ist, dass du ehrlich berätst und Lust hast, besser zu werden.

Benefits

Möglichkeit auf einen eigenen Firmenwagen. Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, einen eigenen Firmenwagen zu bekommen. So bist du für Kundentermine flexibel unterwegs und musst dir um dein eigenes Auto keine Gedanken machen.

Techniker an deiner Seite. Du verkaufst nichts, was hinterher keiner liefern kann. Unsere Techniker planen mit dir und kommen mit zum Kunden.

Moderne Tooling-Kultur. KI-gestütztes Arbeiten für Recherche, Angebote und Vorbereitung statt Zettelwirtschaft.

Wellpass oder Streaming-Abo. Sport in tausenden Studios deutschlandweit oder Spotify bzw. Netflix auf uns. Such dir aus, was zu dir passt.

Bildungsurlaub ist willkommen. Kein unangenehmes Gespräch, kein schlechtes Gewissen. Wer sich weiterbilden will, hat unsere volle Unterstützung.

Start-up-Flair. Kurze Entscheidungswege, echte Eigenverantwortung und eine Atmosphäre, in der Ideen mehr zählen als Hierarchien.

Flexible Arbeitszeiten. Leben und Arbeit muss man manchmal jonglieren. Dafür hast du bei uns Verständnis und Spielraum.

Das sehen wir als Standard an

  • Ein modern ausgestatteter Arbeitsplatz

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • 38-Stunden-Woche

Wenn du Vertrieb machen willst, bei dem du hinter dem stehst, was du verkaufst, dann bewirb dich bei uns!

  • Feedback weitergeben: Du sammelst kontinuierlich Nutzerfeedback und arbeitest eng mit Product Management und Development zusammen, um unsere Plattform weiterzuentwickeln.

Qualifikation

Dein Profil

  • Verfügbarkeit: Du möchtest dauerhaft 20 Stunden pro Woche arbeiten.
  • Sprachgewandt: Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch.
  • Kundenorientiert: Du hast Freude daran, Nutzer:innen weiterzuhelfen, und reagierst empathisch sowie lösungsorientiert.
  • Tech-affin: Du bist neugierig auf digitale Produkte und Tools wie HubSpot, Jira oder Confluence und arbeitest dich schnell in neue Software ein.
  • Strukturiert: Du behältst auch in lebhaften Phasen den Überblick und dokumentierst deine Arbeitsschritte sorgfältig.
  • Eigenverantwortlich und teamorientiert: Du arbeitest gerne eng mit anderen zusammen, übernimmst aber auch selbstständig Verantwortung.
  • Ein bestimmter Ausbildungs-, Studien- oder Berufsabschluss ist nicht erforderlich.

Von Vorteil, aber kein Muss

  • Erste Erfahrung im Customer Support, Kundenservice oder Helpdesk
  • Erfahrung mit SaaS-Produkten oder B2B-Kund:innen

Auch Bewerbungen von Quereinsteiger:innen sind ausdrücklich willkommen.

Benefits

Warum wir?

  • Startup-Spirit mit echtem Impact: Arbeite in einem ambitionierten Team, das mit seiner Technologie Unternehmen erfolgreicher macht.
  • Learning on the Job: Übernimm von Anfang an Verantwortung – wir unterstützen dich und fördern deine fachliche Entwicklung.
  • Flexible Teilzeit: Wir stimmen die Aufteilung deiner 20 Wochenstunden gemeinsam ab. Du arbeitest hybrid – remote und in unserem Office in Kreuzberg.
  • Attraktive Vergütung: Je nach Erfahrung erhältst du 1.300 € bis 1.800 € brutto pro Monat sowie einen Zuschuss zum BVG-Ticket.
  • Moderne Infrastruktur: Dich erwarten ein großzügiges Office und eine kostenfreie Urban-Sports-Club-Mitgliedschaft.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Du berätst nicht nur zu Software. Du gestaltest Veränderung. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden entwickelst du Prozesse weiter, hinterfragst bestehende Abläufe und entwickelst daraus zukunftsfähige Konzepte mit Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. Du verbindest Kunden-, Prozess- und Produktverständnis und berätst unsere Kunden dabei, welche Lösung für ihre Prozesse fachlich und technisch wirklich sinnvoll ist. Von der Idee über die Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung begleitest du Veränderungsprojekte und führst unsere Kunden sicher durch Entscheidungen und neue Prozesse. KI erweitert dabei deine Möglichkeiten in Analyse und Konzeption. Entscheidend bleibt deine Fähigkeit, die richtigen Fragen zu stellen, Möglichkeiten aufzuzeigen und Kunden durch Veränderung zu führen. Dein Fokus liegt auf Beratung und Transformation: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden neue Prozesse und Lösungen und gestaltest damit die Digitalisierung der Holzindustrie aktiv mit.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Beratung, die weiterdenkt: Du begleitest Kunden aus der Holzindustrie von der ersten Idee bis zum Go-live. Du verstehst ihre Prozesse, hinterfragst Anforderungen und berätst sie, welche Lösung mit Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central wirklich sinnvoll ist.

  • Von Prozessen zur richtigen Lösung: Du kennst die Möglichkeiten von Business Central, unseren Lösungen und Apps und übersetzt gemeinsam mit unseren Entwicklern komplexe Anforderungen in nachhaltige Lösungen.

  • KI nutzen, Beratung stärken: Du setzt KI gezielt für Analyse, Konzeption und Lösungsfindung ein. Die Entscheidung, was fachlich zum Kunden und seinen Manufacturing-Prozessen passt, triffst du mit deinem Branchen- und Lösungsverständnis.

  • Projekte zum Erfolg bringen: Du übernimmst Verantwortung in Projekten, begleitest Tests, Roll-outs sowie Change- und Release-Management und behältst auch bei komplexen Anforderungen den Überblick.

  • Gemeinsam Lösungen schaffen: Du arbeitest eng mit Kunden, Entwicklern und dem Inhouse Consulting zusammen und bringst Fachlichkeit, Technik und Kundenanforderungen zusammen.

Dein Profil

  • Consulting-Mindset: Du hast erste Erfahrung im Consulting und möchtest Kunden nicht nur begleiten, sondern beraten, Anforderungen hinterfragen und die beste Lösung mit ihnen entwickeln.

  • Manufacturing-Verständnis: Du kennst Prozesse aus Produktion und Fertigung und hast Lust, dein Wissen über die Holzindustrie weiter auszubauen.

  • Business-Central-Know-how: Du kennst Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central oder möchtest die Lösung und ihre Möglichkeiten von Grund auf verstehen.

  • Kunden- & Kommunikationsstärke: Du arbeitest gerne direkt mit Kunden, kannst komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich erklären und kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch.

  • Reisebereitschaft: Du schätzt den persönlichen Kontakt und bist gerne auch vor Ort bei unseren Kunden.

Was wir bieten

  • Deep Dive statt Dienst nach Vorschrift: Intensive Einarbeitung in unsere Microsoft-Dynamics-Welt und in die Besonderheiten der Holzbranche

  • Wachstum, das zu dir passt: Individuelle Weiterbildungen für deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung

  • Tech up your Workday: Modernste digitale Ausstattung in einer zukunftssicheren Branche

  • Work-Life, wie sie dir gefällt: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, Vertrauensarbeitszeit & Remote-Option

  • Teamspirit inklusive: Kollegiales Miteinander, motiviertes Team & regelmäßige Team- und Firmenevents

  • Mehr fürs Morgen: Zuschuss zur Altersvorsorge & zum Deutschland-Ticket

  • JobRad & Co.: Nachhaltig unterwegs mit dem Rad – plus attraktive Corporate Benefits

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) - AI Enablement & Adoption
description:
Über XCNT

XCNT baut Software mit einem digitalen Herzen und einer industriellen Seele als digitaler Produktbuilder der PARIGROUP SE. Die Ideen entstehen innerhalb dieser europäischen Herstellergruppe und werden so gestaltet, dass sie darüber hinaus skalieren.

Wir bei XCNT arbeiten daran, künstliche Intelligenz im Unternehmensalltag nutzbar zu machen. Gemeinsam mit den Unternehmen unserer Gruppe identifizieren wir passende Anwendungsfälle, entwickeln unsere KI-Angebote weiter und unterstützen Mitarbeitende dabei, sie sinnvoll einzusetzen.

Dabei geht es nicht darum, möglichst viele Tools vorzustellen. Wir wollen konkrete Probleme lösen und KI dort in Arbeitsabläufe integrieren, wo sie wirklich hilft.

Dafür suchen wir dich: Du hast Freude an Technologie, gehst offen auf Menschen zu und möchtest gemeinsam mit ihnen herausfinden, wie KI ihre tägliche Arbeit verbessern kann.

Deine Aufgaben im Bereich AI Enablement & Adoption

Du machst aus ersten KI-Experimenten eine hilfreiche Routine.

Ob im persönlichen Austausch, in abteilungsspezifischen Workshops oder gemeinsam mit unseren AI Champions: Du hilfst Mitarbeitenden, passende Anwendungen zu finden, Hürden zu überwinden und KI selbstständig einzusetzen. Gleichzeitig bringst du ihre Erfahrungen und Anforderungen in die Weiterentwicklung unserer internen KI-Plattform auf Basis von OpenWebUI ein.

AI Enablement & Adoption – rund 70 %

  • Im Alltag unterstützen: Du bist Ansprechperson für Fragen zur KI-Nutzung. Du hilfst bei konkreten Problemen und bindest bei Bedarf die richtigen Fachleute ein.

  • Abteilungsspezifische Workshops gestalten: Du bereitest Workshops auf Deutsch und Englisch vor und führst sie durch – mit echten Aufgaben der jeweiligen Teams statt allgemeiner Tool-Demos.

  • AI Champions unterstützen: Du begleitest engagierte Mitarbeitende, die KI in ihren Bereichen voranbringen, und unterstützt ihren Austausch untereinander.

  • Anwendungsfälle gemeinsam entwickeln: Du findest mit den Teams heraus, wo KI sinnvoll unterstützen kann, erprobst passende Ansätze und begleitest die ersten Schritte im Alltag.

  • Wissen zugänglich machen: Du bereitest hilfreiche Beispiele, Anleitungen und Best Practices so auf, dass andere sie direkt nutzen können.

  • Dranbleiben: Du fragst nach, ob Lösungen tatsächlich helfen, und erkennst, wo weitere Unterstützung nötig ist.

Dazu gehört auch der gelegentliche Austausch vor Ort in den Unternehmen unserer Gruppe. Die Stelle ist also mit Reisen verbunden (DE/Europa).

Nutzerbedürfnisse & Produktanforderungen – rund 30 %

  • Bedarf verstehen: Du sammelst Feedback aus Workshops, Support-Anfragen und Gesprächen mit unseren AI Champions.

  • Anforderungen für OpenWebUI formulieren: Du beschreibst nachvollziehbar, welches Problem gelöst werden soll, für wen es relevant ist und was eine hilfreiche Lösung leisten muss.

  • Muster erkennen: Du unterscheidest zwischen einzelnen Rückfragen, Schulungsbedarf und wiederkehrenden Produktanforderungen.

  • Verbesserungen begleiten: Du stimmst Anforderungen mit dem technischen Team ab, testest neue Funktionen aus Nutzersicht und erklärst sie den Mitarbeitenden.

Du musst dafür keine vollständigen Softwarelösungen allein entwickeln. Wichtig ist, dass du technische Zusammenhänge verstehst und zwischen Anwendern und Entwicklung vermitteln kannst.

Dein Profil

  • Du bist eingeschrieben, idealerweise am Anfang deines Masterstudiums – beispielsweise in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang im ersten oder zweiten Semester.

  • Du nutzt generative KI bereits praktisch und kannst erklären, wo sie hilfreich ist und wo ihre Grenzen liegen.

  • Du gehst gerne auf Menschen zu, hörst aufmerksam zu und fragst nach, bevor du eine Lösung vorschlägst.

  • Du kannst technische Themen verständlich vermitteln und hast Freude daran, andere beim Lernen zu unterstützen.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und eigenständig und behältst offene Fragen im Blick.

  • Du bringst ein grundlegendes Verständnis für Software und webbasierte Anwendungen mit.

  • Du kommunizierst sehr gut auf Deutsch und Englisch.

Ein Plus, kein Muss: Erste Erfahrungen mit OpenWebUI, Workshops, Anwendersupport, Anforderungsmanagement oder Automatisierung.

Deine ersten Monate

Woran du merkst, dass du einen guten Job machst

  • Mitarbeitende kommen bei ihren konkreten Aufgaben weiter – durch deine Unterstützung oder weil du sie an die richtige Stelle vermittelt hast.

  • Teams nutzen KI nach einem Workshop eigenständig und sinnvoll weiter.

  • Unsere AI Champions können ihre Kolleginnen und Kollegen besser unterstützen.

  • Wiederkehrende Hürden werden sichtbar und fließen als klare Anforderungen in die Weiterentwicklung unserer KI-Plattform ein.

Kurz: Nicht die Zahl deiner Workshops zählt, sondern ob deine Arbeit den Alltag der Menschen verbessert.

Was die Rolle besonders macht

  • Du verbindest Technologie, Zusammenarbeit und praktische Problemlösung.

  • Du gestaltest mit, wie KI in unterschiedlichen Unternehmen und Fachbereichen eingesetzt wird.

  • Du bekommst direktes Feedback und siehst, was deine Arbeit bewirkt.

  • Du kannst eigene Ideen einbringen und Schritt für Schritt Verantwortung übernehmen.

Arbeiten bei XCNT

  • Barrierefreier Zugang zum Arbeitsplatz

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge

  • Firmenlaptop

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice-Optionen

  • Kostenlose Getränke und Teamevents sowie Firmenfeiern

  • Möglichkeit zum Remote arbeiten

  • Vorteile bei öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln und Entschädigung für Reisekosten

  • Haustiere erlaubt und zusätzliche Urlaubstage

Vergütung

  • Werkstudententätigkeit

  • Vergütung nach Stunden

  • 30 Tage Urlaub bei 5-Tage-Woche (sonst anteilig)

• Standort: Berlin, hybrid (mittwochs ist Büro-Tag)

• Start: ab sofort

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten, idealerweise 20 Stunden pro Woche
