title: Sachbearbeitung Servicemanagement (m/w/d)
description:
Vollzeit | Standort Bochum | Schicht- und Rufdienstmodell

Wenn Organisation auf Technik trifft und Dein Job wirklich zählt.

CareUnit Service GmbH betreut bundesweit gewerblich genutzte Kälte-, Klima- und Gebäudetechnik. Von unserem Standort in Bochum aus koordinieren wir Kunden, eigene Fachkompetenz und ein leistungsfähiges Servicenetzwerk. Unser Anspruch: technisch gute Lösungen, verlässliche Abläufe und eine Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe.

Warum diese Position wichtig ist

Wenn Kälte- oder Klimatechnik ausfällt, muss schnell und verlässlich gehandelt werden. Du bist die verbindende Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, Technik und Servicepartnern. Du nimmst Anliegen auf, setzt Prioritäten, koordinierst die nächsten Schritte und hältst alle Beteiligten auf dem Laufenden.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Störmeldungen entgegennehmen, einordnen und die nächsten Schritte verbindlich koordinieren

  • Serviceeinsätze mit unseren Partnern organisieren und parallele Vorgänge sicher im Blick behalten

  • Serviceaufträge in Microsoft Dynamics NAV anlegen, nachverfolgen und sauber abschließen

  • Kunden proaktiv über Bearbeitungsstände und Lösungen informieren

  • Arbeitsberichte, Rückmeldungen, Unterlagen und Ersatzteilvorgänge zusammenführen

  • Im First-Level-Support erste Hilfestellung geben und technische Informationen strukturiert aufnehmen

  • Gemeinsam mit dem Team die Servicequalität im Tagesgeschäft sicherstellen

Das bringst Du mit

  • Kaufmännischer Hintergrund oder gutes technisches Verständnis; Quereinsteiger mit Lernbereitschaft sind willkommen

  • Freude daran, sich in technische und komplexe Abläufe einzuarbeiten

  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise und ein sicheres Gespür für Dringlichkeit und Prioritäten

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Verbindliche, respektvolle Kommunikation und eigenständiges Entscheiden im vereinbarten Rahmen

  • Ruhe, Serviceorientierung und Lösungsstärke auch in zeitkritischen Situationen

  • Bereitschaft für versetzte Arbeitszeiten von Montag bis Freitag sowie für fair vergütete Rufdienste

Was diese Position besonders macht

Das ist kein klassischer Callcenter-Job. Unsere Fälle sind individuell, technisch geprägt und häufig zeitkritisch. Die Einarbeitung braucht deshalb Zeit und wird eng begleitet. Du lernst nicht nur Abläufe, sondern auch technische Zusammenhänge und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung.

Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem wachsenden, zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen

  • Strukturierte und persönlich begleitete Einarbeitung

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege, flache Hierarchien und Raum für eigene Ideen

  • Unterstützung bei fachlicher Weiterbildung und persönlicher Entwicklung

  • Leistungsbezogene Prämien

  • Gesundheitsbonus von 300 EUR, z. B. für Zahnreinigung, Sehhilfe oder Vorsorge

  • Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und zu vermögenswirksamen Leistungen

  • Möglichkeit zum Fahrradleasing sowie Angebote unseres Gesundheitsprogramms CareHuman

  • Zusätzliche Vergütung für Ruf- und Bereitschaftsdienste, die remote von zu Hause geleistet werden können

Ganz offen

Der Job kann fordernd sein: Mehrere Vorgänge laufen gleichzeitig, Kunden erwarten Orientierung und technische Lösungen entstehen nicht immer sofort. Dafür siehst Du unmittelbar, was Deine Arbeit bewirkt. Wenn Du Verantwortung magst, klar kommunizierst und auch unter Druck verlässlich bleibst, bist Du bei uns richtig.

Das passt zu dir? Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen?

Sende uns Deine Bewerbung mit Gehaltsvorstellung und nutze unser Online-Bewerbungsformular.

Deine Ansprechpartnerin Dana El-Mohamad steht Dir unter der Telefonnummer 02327 / 62142-03 gerne zur Verfügung!

Unsere Datenschutzrichtlinie kannst Du auf unserer Internetseite einsehen. Bei weiteren Fragen wende Dich an unseren Datenschutzbeauftragten.

title: Counsel, International (EMEA)
description:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. 

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

Hims & Hers is seeking an enterprising, dynamic and highly self-sufficient Counsel, International to join our fast-paced International Legal team.

In this role, you will be a key player supporting our European footprint with a primary focus on Germany, while also driving expansion into new European markets through our international launch function. Operating at the intersection of healthcare, technology, and e-commerce, you will tackle novel legal questions, bring clarity to complex regulatory frameworks, and partner closely with business leaders to build compliant, high-growth healthcare experiences across Europe.

You will be a central operational driver for our German and pan-European commercial, telehealth, and pharmacy strategy.

 

You Will:

  • Support German Operations: Serve as a key legal advisor on day-to-day matters across Germany advising on healthcare and pharmacy regulations, e-commerce compliance, digital health, and marketing.

  • First-Principles Problem Solving: Untangle complex, novel, or undefined regulatory challenges where traditional precedents don't exist. You will help build legal frameworks using first principles rather than off-the-shelf templates.

  • Deliver Actionable, Concise Advice: Cut through ambiguity and synthesise complex legal risks into clear, commercially pragmatic guidance. Your advice will be direct, risk-calibrated, and focused on business value.

  • Navigate Pharmacy & Healthcare Regs: Advise cross-functional teams on German, Dutch, and cross-European pharmacy regulations, telemedicine rules, prescribing workflows, healthcare compliance and privacy. Particular focus on Germany’s AMG and HWG.

  • Commercial Risk & Disputes: Mitigate commercial risk, negotiate key partner/vendor agreements, and assist with advertising and competition matters (including Germany’s unfair competition / UWG litigation environment).

  • Drive Market Expansion & Growth: Partner with the international launch team to scale existing operations and launch Hims & Hers into new European markets, navigating local regulatory, legal, and operational landscapes from scratch.

 

Who You Are:

  • Qualified Attorney: Admitted to practice in the UK, Germany, or Ireland (other EU jurisdictions considered by exception) with ~5+ years PQE in a top-tier law firm, tech company, or fast-growing digital health/telehealth business.

  • First-Principles Thinker: You thrive on novelty and ambiguity. When faced with a problem that has never been solved before, you dig into core principles to construct creative, compliant paths forward.

  • Pragmatic & Commercial: You balance legal requirements with real-world commercial pressure. You understand what the business values and can move quickly without sacrificing quality or compliance.

  • Exceptional Communicator: You get straight to the point accurately and efficiently. You can explain intricate healthcare or consumer laws to non-lawyers clearly and concisely.

  • Self-Sufficient Operator: You take ownership, run autonomously, and prioritise effectively in a high-velocity environment without needing hand-holding.

 

Nice to Have:

  • Domain Exposure: Prior experience navigating German and/or European pharmacy regulations, digital health/e-health laws, or Germany's unfair competition landscape is strongly favored. GDPR experience will also be viewed favourably, particularly in a healthcare context.

  • Language Skills: German

 

Nice to Have:

  • Preferred: Based in London with a hybrid work structure (time spent in our Old Street office collaborating with team members).

  • Flexible: We are also open to exceptional candidates based remotely in Ireland or Germany.

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

Hims considers all qualified applicants for employment, including applicants with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act, and any similar state or local fair chance laws.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Hims & Hers is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at

To learn more about how we collect, use, retain, and disclose Personal Information, please visit our Global Candidate Privacy Statement.

title: Global Sales Development Representative
description:
Global Sales Development Representative (SDR)

🌍 UK (Remote or Hybrid, it’s up to you!)

💰 Dependent on experience, plus commission

📈 Be part of our success with the opportunity to join our company equity scheme

 

🦸‍♀️ The Role 🦸‍♀️

At Chattermill, we empower leading brands like Uber, Amazon, E.On, Next, and HelloFresh to put customers at the heart of everything they do. Our advanced Customer Experience Intelligence platform uses innovative AI to continuously analyse customer feedback, helping clients make data-driven decisions and elevate their service.

We’re seeking a dynamic Global Sales Development Representative (SDR) to play a pivotal role in our growth journey.

 

👉 What you'll be doing:

You’ll be playing a key role in prospecting and qualifying enterprise opportunities within Chattermill's defined Enterprise ICP. This means you will:

  • Identify, research, and prioritise enterprise target accounts (with $1bn+ revenue) across Europe, the UK, and North America.

  • Build and execute tailored, multi-channel outbound campaigns (email, phone, LinkedIn, video) aimed at senior leaders in CX, Product, Insights, and Voice of Customer roles.

  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads against both our ICP and non-ICP criteria.

  • Book and progress qualified meetings, ensuring a smooth handoff and maintaining an accurate pipeline in HubSpot.

  • Develop strong knowledge of our solution, target customers, and the competitive landscape to engage confidently with enterprise stakeholders.

  • Continuously iterate and refine your messaging, outreach sequences, and targeting strategy based on conversion data and insights.

 

🧰 What you’ll need:

  • 6 - 12 months’ experience in a B2B SaaS environment (preferred)

  • Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple conversations simultaneously

  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced setting

  • Coachable mindset, eager to learn and apply feedback quickly

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, comfortable engaging prospects across phone, email, and LinkedIn

  • Commercial curiosity with a natural ability to understand customer pain points and clearly communicate value


🔎 Our Hiring Process

  1. Introductory asynchronous interview – tell us about yourself and what you’re looking for. Our team will review your submission.

  2. Sales Director interview – discuss your experience and learn more about the role.

  3. A short take-home task – show us how you work.

  4. Meet the team – get to know key team members you’ll be working with.

  5. Co-founder call – explore our values and ensure our growth vision aligns with your goals.

Our Perks

🤸🏽‍♂️ Flexibility & Work Setup

  • Flexible working in a choice-first environment - we trust the way you want to work!

  • Work-from-home allowance to set up your ideal workspace

🌴 Time Off

  • 25 days holiday + local bank holidays, plus an extra day for each year of service

  • Your birthday off

🌱 Growth & Ownership

  • Annual learning & development budget to support your growth (increasing over time)

  • Equity options — share in the company’s success

💚 Health & Wellbeing

  • Monthly health & wellbeing budget, increasing with length of service

  • Optional private healthcare plan

  • Life assurance & income protection (location dependent)

  • Employee Assistance Programme (location dependent) for extra support when you need it

  • Enhanced family leave (location dependent), plus fertility and neonatal leave

🌆 Office Perks

  • If you’re in London, a dog-friendly office with great classes, events, and a rooftop terrace


💖 Our Values 

  • We are obsessed with experience – We take our mission to rid the world of bad Customer Experience seriously, and we practice what we preach.

  • We believe in the power of trust – Whether it's with each other, our customers, partners, or other stakeholders, we always communicate with openness and trust.

  • We act as responsible owners – Whether it's about the company, a team, a project, or a task, having the freedom to make decisions in our area of responsibility is a crucial driver for us.

  • We share a passion for growth & progress – On every level, we’re motivated by taking on new challenges – even if they seem out of reach. We recognise that we are learning machines and we always seek to action feedback and improve collectively.

  • We set our ambitions high but stay humble – We've come together to build a product and a category that’s never been seen before. While we're an ambitious bunch with lofty goals, we don't approach this goal carelessly.

title: Pre-Sales / Sales Engineer
description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Pre-Sales role ⭐️

Our Pre-Sales team strengthens Alan’s Enterprise and Public sector Sales to better handle the specificities of our largest customers.

Here are the main missions of the team you will join:

  • Master our platform and support Sales team by enabling them with insights, expertise and the relevant tools;

  • Listen and understand prospects’ needs and work internally on how Alan can address them best;

  • Build a thorough understanding of the prospect and assess the level of functional alignment with our offering and capabilities;

  • Participate to RFP submissions and build Alan’s response in collaboration with Sales, Insurance and Product experts;

  • Join the customer acquisition journey to evangelize our services and products;

  • Act as voice of the customer feeding Alan’s platform roadmap;

  • Prepare handover for delightful customers’ onboardings;

  • Eventually coordinate the most complex customer onboardings leveraging your unique knowledge of the customer’s requirements and specificities.

You will actively participate in developing this growing function within Alan and edit the company to make our Sales teams the most successful of all!

Given the growing need for onsite customer engagement, this role requires you to be based in Paris or the Île-de-France region (or within a 2-hour door to door distance with the flexibility to travel to Paris on short notice for customer meetings).

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-E level range.

⭐️ You will be a great fit if ⭐️

  • You have 6+ years of experience working in a SaaS environment, including at least 3 in a Pre-Sales / Sales Engineering / Solution Consultant role.

  • You have a talent for quickly getting to the root cause of customers concern through active listening and requirements elicitation;

  • You are assertive and know how to handle objections in a complex environment;

  • You master the art of pitching a product with transparency and without overselling its capabilities ;

  • You have the ability to break down complex issues and identify product gaps to define the best product solutions;

  • You thrive at high level stakeholders’ management;

  • You excel at prioritizing tasks while living up to commitments;

  • You love teamwork and are always eager to learn and grow;

  • You are fluent in both French and English;

It would be even better if you have:

  • Experience with end-to-end procurement projects (buyer or supplier side) with involvement in RFI’s, RFQ’s and RFP’s;

  • Experience in the French Public Sector;

  • Experience in HRIS ecosystems and Payroll solutions;

  • Experience in Insurance or Health platforms.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

  • Comfortable organising events and facilitating sessions, in connection with the projects mentioned.
  • Availability for a 6-month internship starting in January 2027 is required.
Skills:

  • Genuine interest in AI
  • Appetite for project management, data analysis and cross-functional collaboration
  • Strong communication skills in French and English

  • Collaborative tools (e.g. Notion, Google Workspace, or equivalent)
 

5. Languages

  • French: Fluent (C2 level required)
  • English: Professional proficiency (B2 minimum, C1 preferred)
 

6. Compensation, Perks & Benefits

  1. Pay Range: €1,200 – €1,400 per month, based on your level of study.

    • A workplace that supports well-being and balance: breakfasts, fitness and yoga classes, after-work events, game nights
    • Mentoring from senior technical experts and regular feedback to support your growth
    • Immersion in a collaborative, international team passionate about sharing knowledge

    • Gymlib pass for your well-being

    • Swile meal vouchers

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.

title: R&D Facility & Safety Specialist
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

YOUR IMPACT

As an R&D Facility & Safety Specialist, you will work with the Engineering Program, Safety and Operations teams to ensure the smooth and safe operation of Proxima’s Swiss industrial facilities. This is a high-ownership role requiring strong organizational and communication skills supporting structured technical thinking.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Act as the Sicherheitsbeauftragte/r (SiBe) or Safety Contact Person for Proxima Fusion’s Swiss subsidiary.

    • Coordinate our safety organisation and keep its documentation up to date

    • Coordinate risk assessments with team leads and external safety specialists

    • Investigate incidents and near misses, and advise management on risks and corrective actions

    • Own emergency and evacuation planning, first-aider coverage and drills

    • Manage safety inductions, safety training, and access rights to facilities

    • Act as the point of contact for regulators and authorities

  • Organise the day-to-day running of our two Swiss R&D facilities: workspace layout and housekeeping, shared areas and equipment booking, storage, waste disposal, and the interface with building owners and neighbors

  • Own maintenance and operations of our tooling, equipment and technical infrastructure: preventive maintenance, repairs, calibration, and inspections

  • Manage and procure consumables and stock materials for manufacturing

WHO YOU ARE

  • An experienced technician, technical engineer, safety engineer, or operations specialist with experience in hardware development environments

  • At least 3 years of work experience in either a research institute or an industrial setting

  • Holding SiBe/KOPAS training (SUVA or equivalent), or willing to complete it in your first three months; experienced applying health and safety practice in Switzerland or the EU

  • A proactive, detail-oriented team player who takes full ownership of delivering results.

  • A confident, self-aware communicator who collaborates well and can negotiate effectively with suppliers and external partners.

  • Fluent in German and conversational in English.

  • Holding a driving license valid in Switzerland.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Training or qualifications in industrial safety

  • Experience in warehouse management - knowledge of incoming goods best practices and experience building an in-house process.

  • Knowledge of fire safety and industrial hazards

  • Experience with cryogenic, pressure equipment, chemical and electrical hazards

  • Experience with heavy lift equipment and operations

  • First aid training

  • Qualified in Switzerland to operate overhead cranes or forklifts

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

description:
Content Creator & Online Marketing (20 %)


Teilzeit (20 %)

Du liebst Social Media, hast kreative Ideen, bist KI-affin und weisst, wie man mit einem spannende Inhalte produziert? Dann suchen wir genau dich!

Die Hüsser & Palkoska AG ist ein vielseitiges Automobilunternehmen mit Standorten in Baar und Neuheim. Von der klassischen Werkstatt über Elektromobilität und Fahrzeughandel bis hin zu unserer neuen Carrosserie- und Lackiererei bieten wir ein breites Spektrum rund ums Automobil.

Wir möchten unsere Geschichten, unser Fachwissen und die Menschen hinter unserem Unternehmen noch stärker sichtbar machen. Dafür suchen wir eine kreative und selbstständige Persönlichkeit, die unseren digitalen Auftritt aktiv mitgestaltet.

Bei uns musst du keine aufwendigen Filmproduktionen erstellen. Wir setzen auf authentische Inhalte, gute Ideen und eine unkomplizierte Umsetzung mit Smartphone.

Was erwartet dich?

  • Selbstständige Ideenfindung und Entwicklung spannender Inhalte rund um unseren Betrieb

  • Beobachtung aktueller Social-Media-Trends und Einbringen neuer Ideen

  • Einfache Auswertung der veröffentlichten Inhalte und ihrer Reichweite

Was wünschen wir uns von dir?

  • Freude an Social Media

  • Erfahrung mit CapCut

  • Sicherer Umgang mit dem Smartphone für Video- und Fotoaufnahmen

  • Kreativität und ein gutes Gespür für interessante Geschichten

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und Freude am Schreiben

  • Wohnort vorzugsweise in der Region Zug

Wichtig zu wissen:

Ein wesentlicher Teil deiner Arbeit findet direkt in unseren Betrieben statt. Für Filmaufnahmen, Interviews und die Sammlung interessanter Geschichten bist du mindestens einen halben Tag pro Woche vor Ort.

Die Ideenfindung, Planung, Videobearbeitung und Texterstellung kannst du nach Absprache auch von zu Hause aus erledigen. Dafür verwendest du deine eigenen Geräte wie Smartphone und Laptop. An unseren Standorten stellen wir dir die notwendigen Arbeitsgeräte zur Verfügung. Für die Arbeit im Homeoffice werden keine Geräte bereitgestellt.

Eine vollständig remote ausgeführte Tätigkeit ist nicht möglich.

Was kannst du von uns erwarten?

  • Eine abwechslungsreiche Teilzeitstelle

  • Viel Freiraum für eigene Ideen und kreative Umsetzungen

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit klar geregelter Präsenz vor Ort

Du fühlst dich angesprochen?

Überzeuge uns mit deiner Kreativität, deiner Persönlichkeit und deiner Motivation. Wir sind gespannt darauf, dich kennenzulernen und mehr über deine Ideen zu erfahren.

title: Enterprise Solutions Architect
description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking an Enterprise Solutions Architect with deep expertise in life science R&D and enterprise software systems to partner with Benchling's customers in driving the biotech revolution forward.

The Enterprise Solutions Architect serves as a strategic advisor and technical leader for our enterprise customers, translating their IT strategy into tailored Benchling solutions. This role encompasses guiding organizations through digital transformation, leading technical implementation projects, overseeing solution architecture, and establishing best practices and data architecture standards to ensure long-term success.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Partner with biotechnology organizations at the forefront of innovation to assess their IT landscape, understand strategic objectives, and architect solutions that enable mission-critical outcomes.

  • Lead end-to-end implementation projects from discovery through successful go-live and adoption.

  • Provide ongoing strategic guidance, best practice education, and product engagement recommendations to maximize customer value realization.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional business and technology stakeholders to gather requirements, identify opportunities, and translate business needs into technical solutions in partnership with internal engineering, product, and solutions architecture teams.

  • Coordinate with Professional Services, Product, and Customer Success teams to orchestrate complex, global enterprise deployments.

  • Support Sales and Marketing in technical deal strategy, and engage with Engineering, Product, and Solutions Architecture teams to resolve complex technical challenges.

  • Contribute to the development and refinement of global enterprise processes, product capabilities, and best practice frameworks.

  • Partner with biotechnology organizations at the forefront of innovation to assess their IT landscape, understand strategic objectives, and architect solutions that enable mission-critical outcomes.

QUALIFICATIONS

 Required

  • 5-10+ years of combined experience in biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry roles and scientific software implementation.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Sciences, Information Management, or related field (advanced degree preferred).

  • Proven track record leading global implementation teams in enterprise solution design and deployment (Benchling experience strongly preferred).

  • Demonstrated ability to empathize with scientists and rapidly comprehend complex scientific concepts and workflows.

  • Exceptional communication skills across verbal, written, and presentation formats, coupled with strong organizational and project management capabilities.

  • Self-directed, adaptable professional who thrives in dynamic, fast-paced environments.

  • Comfortable operating across functions, organizational levels, and geographies with diverse stakeholder groups.

  • Willingness to travel to customer sites up to 30% based on project requirements.

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience implementing scientific/informatics platforms such as LIMS, ELN, MES, LES, and analytical tools including JMP, Spotfire, or Tableau.

HOW WE WORK

We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).

About Refinery89



Refinery89 is a Dutch AdTech company headquartered in Madrid, working with premium publishers worldwide to optimize programmatic advertising performance.

Through advanced, data-driven technology, we help publishers maximize advertising revenue, improve monetization efficiency, and gain greater transparency across their advertising operations.

Our international team brings together specialists in programmatic advertising, publisher monetization, technology, and account management to deliver measurable results for our partners.

About the Role



Are you currently working in Programmatic Advertising, Ad Operations, Campaign Management, or Publisher Monetization and looking to take the next step in your career?

We're looking for a Dutch-speaking Programmatic Advertising Specialist to join our Publisher Success team in Amsterdam.

This opportunity is ideal for someone with a solid understanding of digital advertising who wants to move beyond campaign execution and take on a more strategic, publisher-facing role.

You don't need previous Account Management experience. We're particularly interested in candidates who understand the programmatic advertising ecosystem, enjoy analyzing performance, solving technical challenges, and communicating with clients.

You'll work directly with Dutch publishers, helping them optimize their advertising performance, maximize revenue, and develop long-term partnerships with Refinery89.

You'll collaborate closely with our Technical Account Managers, AdTech specialists, Product, and Sales teams to deliver the best possible experience for our publishing partners.

Key Responsibilities



Publisher Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with publishers in the Netherlands.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

What We're Looking For

Who Should Apply?

Why Join Refinery89?

  • Work at a growing international AdTech company with Dutch roots.

Whether you're currently managing advertising campaigns, optimizing programmatic performance, or supporting publisher monetization, this could be your opportunity to take on greater responsibility and develop your career in AdTech.

Apply today and join Refinery89's Publisher Success team in Amsterdam.

title: Model-Based Systems Engineer
description:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

Our Systems Integration Team is seeking a Model-Based Systems Engineer to build the tools and framework we use to design the systems that operate our VIO and QPU technology. This role is focused on establishing QuantWare’s MBSE methodology and turning knowledge from cryogenics, wiring, control electronics and software into a single, executable system model. You will define how we model our systems and build the libraries, analyses and integrations that make the model useful day to day. Working closely with processor, hardware and software teams, you will play an important role in enabling the design of the large-scale quantum computers built around VIO-powered QPUs.

What are you going to do?

  • Define and own QuantWare’s MBSE methodology, modelling conventions and architecture framework for quantum computing systems, covering the quantum processor, cryostat, signal chain, control and readout electronics, and software stack.

  • Select, set up and maintain the MBSE toolchain (e.g. SysML v2, Capella or Cameo), including version control, model reviews and integration with existing engineering tools.

  • Build reusable model libraries for key subsystems, including QPU interfaces, cryogenic wiring and attenuation, microwave signal paths, and control electronics.

  • Develop automated analyses on top of the model, such as heat-load, signal-integrity and noise budgets, channel counts, scalability, and full-system metrics such as power consumption as qubit counts grow.

  • Establish requirements traceability from customer and system-level requirements down to component specifications and verification tests.

  • Connect the system model to simulation and measurement data, creating a digital thread between design and test.

  • Support system architecture and trade studies for new VIO and QPU generations and customer system integrations.

  • Drive adoption across the company, training and supporting engineers in using the models and tools in their day-to-day work.

Qualifications

Core Requirements:

  • BSc. or MSc. in systems engineering, electrical engineering, physics, mechanical engineering or a related field.

  • 3+ years of hands-on MBSE experience, including building or extending a modelling framework rather than only using existing ones.

  • Hands on experience with hardware system models that encompass multiple subsystems with differing requirements and interfaces.

  • Strong working knowledge of SysML (v1 and/or v2) and at least one MBSE tool, such as Cameo, Capella or equivalent.

  • Proficiency in Python for model automation, analysis and tool integration via APIs.

  • A solid track record in requirements engineering and verification of complex, multidisciplinary hardware systems.

  • Strong organisational and communication skills. You thrive in a cross-disciplinary environment and are comfortable taking ownership from day one.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with cryogenic, RF/microwave or precision instrumentation systems, or direct experience with superconducting quantum hardware.

  • Background in high-tech, semiconductor, aerospace or scientific instrumentation industries.

  • Experience introducing MBSE into an organisation and driving its adoption.

  • Familiarity with SysML v2 APIs, digital thread concepts or co-simulation (e.g. FMI), as well as systems engineering standards such as ISO/IEC 15288.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

OTHER REQUIREMENTS

Compensation

Additional Information

Join us in shaping the future of real estate

The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.

We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.

Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.

More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner.

Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform.

Luxury Presence is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

title: Helpdesk Technician Tier 1
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We are seeking a reliable, tech-savvy, and customer-focused Tier 1 Help Desk Technician to join our IT team. This position is responsible for providing first-level support for end-user IT issues, including hardware, software, and basic networking problems.

You’re welcome to work remotely in Singapore.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Serve as the first point of contact for users seeking technical assistance in person, messaging, ticket, or email.
  • Log, categorize, and prioritize all incoming support requests in the IT ticketing system.
  • Analyze, troubleshoot, resolve and document a broad scope of hardware, software, and peripheral issues (e.g., printers, monitors, network).
  • Assist with user account creation, password resets, and access permissions in Active Directory and other enterprise systems.
  • Install, configure, and maintain desktop/laptop computers, mobile devices, and software applications.
  • Escalate complex or unresolved issues to Tier 2/3 support in a timely manner.
  • Maintain and update asset inventory records.
  • Facilitate and support seamless onboarding and off-boarding processes, including workstation setup, re-imaging and return.
  • Follow standard procedures for proper escalation and ticket closure.
  • Provide excellent customer service by ensuring timely and clear communication with end users.
  • Extensively document actions taken and suggested resolutions in detail.
  • Actively contribute to IT knowledge base.
  • Assist with regular IT maintenance tasks, such as software updates and hardware checks (for both user endpoints and office infrastructure).
  • Ensure compliance with company IT policies and procedures.

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Exhaust all possible scenarios within their access level when attempting to resolve an issue
  • Proactively seek feedback from peers, mentors, and leaders
  • Exhibits prideful ownership of work and proactively champions the needs of the team, users, and projects
  • Contribute to continuous service improvement by participating in projects and driving operational enhancements.
  • Build meaningful and fruitful relationships within the team and cross functionally
  • Fearlessly seek improvement personally, within processes, and within the team’s culture

We expect you to have:

  • An IT customer support background with 4+ years of service desk technical experience.
  • Advanced troubleshooting skills in AV systems, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365 (including Office 365), networking, software and MDM administration, along with experience managing enterprise applications such as Slack, Jira, Zoom, and similar tools.
  • Technical documentation and knowledge base (KB) writing skills.
  • Hands-on experience with Jira or comparable service management systems.
  • A customer-first mindset, prioritizing employee satisfaction and support quality.
  • The ability to independently resolve technical issues across the support portfolio.
  • Strong organizational skills with the capacity to effectively prioritize and manage a busy workload.
  • A collaborative spirit, working seamlessly with cross-functional team members to meet employee needs and achieve company goals.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

title: Enterprise Sales Executive, AI Solutions
description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As an Enterprise Sales Executive at Toptal, you will be a key driver of growth within our AI Solutions business. In this role, you will identify, develop, and close opportunities with enterprise clients by helping them solve complex business challenges through forward-deployed AI solutions, AI software and platforms, AI services, and AI-enabled transformation.

You will develop tailored solutions that help clients move from AI strategy and experimentation into production, combining Toptal’s capabilities across AI Strategy & Transformation, Agentic Solutions, Data Services, AI Platforms, Industry Solutions, Joint Partner Solutions, and Managed Services to achieve measurable business outcomes.

This role is designed for true hunters who thrive in a high-performance, client-facing environment. It is ideal for individuals who have successfully sold enterprise AI solutions and are passionate about building a book of business from the ground up, forging executive relationships, and creating long-term client value. Success in this role is measured by your ability to convert new enterprise relationships into durable revenue and establish Toptal as a core AI services provider embedded in your clients’ most critical initiatives.

Enterprise AI has shifted rapidly from experimentation to execution. Companies are investing in models, agents, AI platforms, data infrastructure, and AI-enabled applications, but many are struggling to translate those investments into production systems and measurable business outcomes.

The challenge is no longer simply selecting an AI model or platform. Enterprises must identify the right workflows, connect AI to their proprietary data and knowledge, integrate existing systems, build and deploy agents and applications, establish evaluation and control frameworks, drive adoption, and continuously operate and improve AI in production.

Toptal brings together world-class AI and domain talent, forward-deployed solution delivery, AI platforms and capabilities, strategic technology partners, expert-in-the-loop operations, and managed services to help enterprises move from AI promise to production.

This role exists to convert that market opportunity into new enterprise relationships and position Toptal as a strategic partner for companies deploying AI across their organizations.

This is a remote position with significant client-facing fieldwork across the US. Applicants who reside within commutable distance of a major metropolitan area are strongly preferred. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

*The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

You will be responsible for building a targeted portfolio of accounts via identifying, prioritizing, and developing your own book of business rather than inheriting an existing one. Once you have signed net new customers, you will partner with Client Partners to deepen and expand those strategic relationships over time.

Net new accounts may begin with a specific AI initiative, workflow, platform implementation, or business problem requiring a disciplined approach to defining the opportunity and matching the right Toptal capabilities to the client’s needs. As relationships mature, accounts become more complex, with deeper engagement across multiple business units, workflows, technology platforms, and senior executive relationships.

These accounts demand a highly consultative, strategic approach that includes navigating cross-functional priorities, understanding the client’s AI and technology environment, aligning solutions to evolving business objectives, and demonstrating credibility at the C-suite level. Success will require the ability to adapt your engagement style to the maturity and complexity of each account while consistently driving measurable client value and long-term growth.

  • Own and build a portfolio of enterprise AI accounts, with direct accountability for new logo acquisition, revenue growth, and client outcomes.
  • Prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close new opportunities in close partnership with our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), while expanding the relationships you establish.
  • Define and execute account strategy, including opportunity creation, pipeline development, and multi-year growth planning.
  • Lead AI solution development and deal execution in partnership with AI Services leadership, Industry GMs, Practice Leaders, Pursuits, Partnerships, and Delivery teams.
  • Partner with Client Partners to drive coordinated account expansion and maximize total account value as accounts mature.
  • Shape AI solutions that apply Toptal’s capabilities across AI Strategy & Transformation, Agentic Solutions, Data Services, AI Platforms, Industry Solutions, Joint Partner Solutions, and Managed Services to clients’ most important business and operating challenges.
  • Maintain disciplined pipeline and account intelligence to support accurate forecasting and informed decision-making.
  • Lead strategic conversations with prospective and existing clients, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard with Toptal and meet your TopPal.
  • Learn the core of Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our deep capabilities.
  • Familiarize yourself with the tools and resources needed to be successful.
  • Dive into our sales methods, our selling processes, and playbooks.
  • Become familiar with our contracting and legal methodologies, templates, tools, and processes.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Meet key Toptal stakeholders who will support your success and the success of the overall team.
  • Learn about the Toptal AI Go-To-Market Strategy, our key sales plays, solution portfolio, partner ecosystem, and client engagement model.
  • Work with AI Services leadership to establish a portfolio strategy and build account plans.
  • Shadow key calls and client meetings.
  • Begin to meet with clients, leveraging your existing enterprise AI network and relationships, to articulate Toptal’s capabilities and identify where we can help organizations move AI into production.
  • Begin prospecting and actively engaging target accounts within your portfolio.
  • Meet with SDRs, Client Partners, and cross-functional team members to align on joint account strategies.
  • Collaborate with Pursuits and Delivery teams to understand how we design AI engagements.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Exercise discretion and independent judgment in the negotiation of contracts, work collaboratively with clients, and help them engage with Toptal’s AI capabilities and specialists.
  • Begin shaping AI solutions that resonate with your target accounts, including forward-deployed AI solutions, Outcome Agents, agentic workflows, enterprise data and knowledge solutions, AI platforms, and managed AI services, demonstrating your comfort and ability in working with ambiguity and directly innovating alongside your clients.
  • Establish credibility with client stakeholders through informed, consultative engagement tied to their AI priorities, business workflows, existing technology investments, and desired outcomes.
  • Own your pipeline and forecast with confidence.
  • Develop proposals and close your first set of deals.
  • Actively contribute to team rituals, best practice sharing, and win/loss reviews.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Have an initial base of active clients while continuing to build your overall portfolio.
  • Expand your buyer network and deepen executive engagement across your accounts.
  • Drive net new opportunities by introducing additional AI capabilities, platforms, solutions, partners, and managed services and displacing incumbent providers.
  • Shape and influence client priorities, aligning Toptal’s AI solutions to critical business objectives and measurable, validated outcomes.
  • Execute against a defined growth plan tied to measurable outcomes.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Have built a list of incredible client accounts, advising them on how to utilize Toptal’s AI capabilities to address their priorities and key business challenges.
  • Establish and expand a strong executive network across your portfolio, building a foundation of advocates and sponsors.
  • Begin to mentor new members of the team, teaching them about Toptal, our AI model, and how to successfully grow their territory.
  • Be recognized for your subject matter expertise in enterprise AI solutions, leveraging your existing network and relationships as well as your proven consultative selling skills to drive meaningful results for your clients and the overall AI Services team.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 7-10+ years of experience in enterprise technology, AI software, professional services, or consulting sales, with a strong foundation in enterprise account development and complex solution selling.
  • Direct experience selling enterprise AI solutions is required, ideally including forward-deployed AI solutions, AI software or platforms, AI consulting and professional services, or managed AI services.
  • Extensive experience in consultative customer engagement and selling service-oriented, technology-enabled, or outcome-based solutions to enterprise clients.
  • Demonstrated success building a book of business from the ground up, i.e. self-sourcing, prospecting, and developing new enterprise relationships rather than relying on an inherited portfolio.
  • Proven track record managing a $5M+ annualized gross portfolio and closing $250K-$1M+ complex, multi-phase deals with enterprise clients with $2B+ in annual revenue.
  • Must be comfortable engaging C-level executives on how AI is changing their business, technology environment, operating model, workforce, and competitive landscape.
  • A well-rounded understanding of enterprise AI challenges and trends, including generative AI, agentic AI, AI applications and platforms, enterprise data and knowledge, models, workflow automation, governance, evaluation, controls, and managed AI operations.
  • Ability to have informed discussions about how AI moves from strategy and experimentation into real enterprise workflows and production environments, including the importance of context, data, integration, validation, governance, adoption, and ongoing operations.
  • Experience selling solutions involving leading AI, cloud, data, or enterprise technology platforms, and the ability to work in a platform-flexible environment across client technology ecosystems.
  • Exposure to hybrid talent models, forward-deployed delivery models, or alternative consulting delivery models.
  • Ability to build and execute account plans that lead to consistent portfolio growth and a healthy pipeline.
  • Proven success in collaborative prospecting, running virtual and on-site sales calls, and leading sales pursuits backed by a multidisciplinary team.
  • Experience negotiating complex service agreements with procurement and legal departments within enterprise accounts.
  • Ability to partner effectively across multiple internal teams to shape innovative solutions that drive client success.
  • Willingness and ability to travel to client sites, conferences, and team events (up to 25%).
  • Passion for solving client problems with creativity and urgency.
  • Regular or periodic travel to meet and engage with Toptal clients and customers both inside and outside of your geographic location.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Compensation

Additional Information

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
Title: Digital Marketing Specialist

Department: Marketing

Reporting to: AD, Digital and Partner Marketing

Compensation: $58K - $75K USD

Employment: Full Time

Location: USA - Remote

Who we are:

World Education Services (WES) is a non-profit social enterprise that supports the educational, economic, and social inclusion of immigrants, refugees, and international students. For 50 years, WES has set the standard for international academic credential evaluation, supporting millions of people as they seek to achieve their academic and professional goals. Through decades of experience as a leader in global education, WES has developed a wide range of tools to pursue social impact at scale. From evaluating academic credentials to shaping policy, designing programs, and providing philanthropic funding, we partner with a diverse set of organizations, leaders, and networks to uplift individuals and drive systems change. Together with its partners, WES enables people to learn, work, and thrive in new places. For more information about WES, please visit our website at www.WES.org.

About the Opportunity:

The Digital Marketing Specialist plays a critical role in supporting WES’s evolving digital marketing strategy. This position reports to the Associate Direct, Digital and Partner Marketing and focuses on day-to-day execution, reporting, and project management across SEM, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and AI searchability initiatives. The Digital Marketing Specialist assists with high-impact projects such as webinars, conferences, podcast series, and e-commerce transformation.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage and optimize SEM campaigns across Google Ads and other platforms.
  • Implement SEO best practices for website content and landing pages.
  • Support GEO and AI-driven search optimization strategies to improve global visibility and future-proof WES’s digital presence.
  • Monitor campaign performance, analyze data, and prepare reports with actionable insights.
  • Collaborate with the content team to design and produce digital marketing assets for multiple channels (website, paid ads, social media).
  • Coordinate logistics, asset creation, and post-event reporting for applicant-facing webinars and major conferences.
  • Assist in planning, scheduling, and execution of WES’s new podcast series, ensuring timely delivery and cross-team collaboration.
  • Collaborate with internal teams on e-commerce transformation projects to align marketing strategies with new platform capabilities.
  • Review and help fix Google Tags in Google Tag Manager to ensure accurate tracking and reporting.
  • Executing, scheduling, and monitoring email campaigns to build engagement

Your Experience:

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, advertising, business management, or in a related field preferred.
  • At least 2 years' experience as a marketing specialist, or a similar role.
  • Proven SEO experience.
  • Strong understanding of SEM, SEO, GEO, and digital analytics tools (Google Ads, GA4, Tag Manager).
  • Experience in gathering and interpreting customer experience information.
  • Knowledge of online customer engagement platforms and channels.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills and a client-centered approach.
  • Great organizational and time management abilities with the ability to handle shifting workloads and priorities.
  • Experience reporting up and identifying trends or opportunities for process or improvement.
  • Ability to both think strategically and execute tactically.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication.
  • Project work demonstrating understanding of digital user experience and technology platforms.
  • Advanced computer proficiency.
  • Proactive, self-starter who is comfortable working in a remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrates adaptability when it comes to shifting priorities and change.
  • Demonstrate strategic thinking driving campaigns, value propositions and managing multiple projects.
  • Outcome-orientated, quantitative, and qualitative problem-solver; comfortable with ambiguity, displaying superb pattern-recognition abilities.
  • Experienced working in a rapidly evolving, entrepreneurial, technology and service driven, client-focused environment.
  • Action orientated individual, thinking, and leading “out of the box.
  • Strong alignment with WES mission and values and demonstrates a growth mindset

What We Offer:

Joining our team at WES means embarking on a purpose-driven career with a global impact, where you contribute daily to making a tangible difference in the lives of people worldwide. You'll thrive in an employee-centric environment, with access to learning opportunities, pathways for personal and professional development, and recognition of your achievements. Our inclusive, mission-driven culture values employees and focuses on investing in our people through our culture, people framework, and programming while offering the flexibility of remote work options.

  • Work-Life Harmony: We believe that success is all about maintaining balance. Enjoy the freedom of remote work and flexible scheduling, paired with generous time-off policies designed to assist you in maintaining a healthy equilibrium between your personal and professional commitments. Our comprehensive wellness programs and work environment are focused on fostering your well-being.
  • Rewards and Recognition: Your dedication and achievements are the cornerstone of our success. We recognize the importance of valuing your hard work which is why we offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and tangible rewards to celebrate your contributions.
  • Professional Growth and Development: We are committed to nurturing growth within our team, recognizing that growth is essential to providing opportunities for career advancement and ongoing professional development. To prioritize your learning and success, we invest in comprehensive training programs and offer tuition reimbursement opportunities. We promote a culture of continuous learning that empowers you to thrive and evolve in your career.
  • Innovation and Impact: Engage in work that directly transforms lives and empowers individuals and communities by expanding access to global educational and professional pathways. Join us in fostering a culture that values innovation, embraces new approaches, and leverages transformation to implement and drive impactful change.
  • Community and Connection: Our team is made up of individuals from different cultures and backgrounds who have varying perspectives and ideas. Our diverse workforce reflects the global community we serve, and we take pride in it. We are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and included. Experience the power of connection by participating in a range of activities, including employee-led resource groups, town halls, collaborative team events, meaningful volunteer opportunities, and initiatives that promote equity, celebrate diversity, and cultivate a strong sense of belonging within our organization.

Values:

  • Opportunity - We open doors so people can build better futures.
  • Inclusion - We become stronger, more creative, and more resilient when we embrace diversity.
  • Equity - We uphold fairness and justice in our work and actions.
  • Enterprising - We are resourceful, inventive, and driven.
  • Expertise - We challenge ourselves to be the best at what we do.

Inclusive Recruitment Process:

We welcome all applicants, irrespective of their experience perfectly fitting the job description, as we value diverse and innovative viewpoints. At our organization, individuals who thrive in a culture of continuous learning and inclusive teamwork excel. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible work environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and supported and welcome members of all backgrounds and perspectives to apply.

Our Commitment:

At World Education Services, we're committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that reflects the rich tapestry of our communities, both in the US and Canada. This commitment is underscored by our unwavering dedication to providing equal opportunities to all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or genetics. This commitment extends to every aspect of employment, from recruitment and hiring to promotions, training, and benefits. We comply with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination laws. For us, diversity goes beyond compliance – it's about embracing unique perspectives and cultivating an environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential.

If you encounter challenges accessing or using our career site due to a disability, you may request reasonable accommodation by contacting us via email . Our Talent Acquisition team is dedicated to supporting qualified candidates by providing solutions that can meet their needs.

Please be advised that this email address is intended to receive and respond to inquiries concerning the accessibility of the online application system, and requests for assistance and accommodation during any part of the recruitment process. Résumés or applications sent to this email address will not be reviewed.

For more information about WES, please visit our website at.

title: Learning and Development Business Partner
description:
We have a fantastic opportunity for a Learning and Development Business Partner, to join our Senior Leadership Team. This role will be remote with national travel.

Reporting directly to the Group Chief People Officer you will strengthen management capability and team effectiveness across EMED Group through practical, accessible learning. Working in partnership with operational leaders and People colleagues, deliver Management Acceleration Pathway (MAP) modules, bespoke local training and Insights-based development, while expanding and maintaining the online learning library.

This hands-on national role translates business and team development needs into learning that managers can apply every day, supporting consistent management practice, operational effectiveness and patient-centred service delivery.

Benefits for the role include

  • Competitive Salary
  • Annual car allowance
  • Performance related bonus
  • Private Healthcare
  • 33 days annual leave (inclusive of bank holidays) with the option to purchase additional leave through salary sacrifice.
  • Life Assurance
  • 24/7 online/telephone GP Consultation and access to prescriptions.
  • 2nd opinion medical support following diagnosis or where a colleague is on a treatment pathway.
  • Cash-plan benefits, providing colleagues the option of protecting themselves in case of illness and recuperation, including dental, optical, chiropody.
  • Access to mental health and physiotherapy consultations.
  • Access to legal advice on domestic issues e.g. motoring offences, wills and probate, and personal injury.
  • Long Service Recognition Scheme – recognising colleagues for their continued service after 5 years and at 5-year intervals with an increase in annual leave.

Role Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate and deliver MAP modules nationally through face-to-face workshops, virtual sessions and blended learning.
  • Build managers’ practical skills in communication, coaching, constructive feedback, delegation, team development, managing change and everyday management conversations.
  • Tailor examples, exercises and resources to operational settings while maintaining agreed MAP learning outcomes and delivery standards.
  • Work with HR team and subject matter experts to keep management content accurate, relevant and aligned with organisational policies and priorities.
  • Partner with operational leaders and HR Business Partners to understand local priorities and identify management and team development needs.
  • Design and deliver bespoke workshops, team development days and targeted training, adapting relevant MAP modules to meet local needs.
  • Support teams to strengthen communication, collaboration, clarity of responsibilities and shared ownership of agreed actions.
  • Promote MAP, team development and online learning through clear communications that explain the benefits and encourage participation.
  • Equip managers to deliver effective team briefings, listening conversations and communication during change through targeted training and practical resources.
  • Coordinate and deliver Insights-based development sessions in accordance with the chosen tool’s requirements and applicable practitioner accreditation.
  • Help managers and colleagues understand working preferences, adapt communication and collaborate effectively, without labelling people or making assumptions about capability.
  • Support teams to agree practical actions and revisit progress after sessions.
  • Maintain a prioritised development plan for new online modules, informed by management learning needs, recurring local requirements and organisational priorities.
  • Design and build engaging digital modules with clear learning objectives, practical scenarios, knowledge checks and supporting resources.
  • Use evaluation findings to improve programmes and inform priorities, distinguishing the contribution of learning from other factors affecting operational outcomes.

Do you have what it takes?

  • Experience designing and delivering management development and team learning in a multi-site or geographically dispersed organisation.
  • Strong facilitation skills, with the ability to engage different audiences through face-to-face and virtual delivery.
  • Ability to identify learning needs with stakeholders and translate them into practical, proportionate development solutions.
  • Experience creating digital learning modules using authoring tools and working with learning management systems.
  • Understanding of adult learning, blended learning and methods for evaluating learning application.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, strong stakeholder relationships and the confidence to influence without direct authority.
  • Ability to manage a national delivery schedule alongside bespoke requests and content development deadlines.
  • Commitment to accessible learning, confidentiality, respectful working relationships and patient-centred service delivery.
  • Ability to meet the national travel requirements of the role.

Desirable experience and qualifications
