title: HR & Recruitment Coordinator
description:
HR & Recruitment Coordinator

Start your career in HR and Talent Acquisition with BioPhorum

Are you a recent graduate looking to kick-start your career in HR? Are you naturally organised, curious, proactive and someone who enjoys working with people?

We're looking for an enthusiastic Graduate Resourcer & HR Assistant to join our People team at BioPhorum.

This is a great opportunity for someone at the start of their career who wants to gain hands-on experience across recruitment and HR, develop new skills and make a real contribution to a growing international business.

You don't need previous HR or recruitment experience. What matters most to us is your attitude, willingness to learn and desire to get stuck in.

About BioPhorum

BioPhorum is an international organisation that brings together leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies to collaborate, share knowledge and solve some of the industry's biggest challenges.

Our people are at the heart of what we do, and our People team plays an important role in attracting, supporting and developing the talent that helps our business grow.

What will you be doing?

This is a varied role where you'll gain exposure to both recruitment and the wider HR function. You'll work closely with the Talent Partner and wider People team, learning how we attract great people, deliver a positive candidate experience and support employees throughout their time with BioPhorum.

Your responsibilities will include:

Recruitment and Talent Acquisition

  • Supporting the recruitment process from initial application through to interview and appointment.
  • Reviewing applications and identifying candidates who match our requirements.
  • Helping to source and engage potential candidates through different recruitment channels.
  • Coordinating interviews, communicating with candidates and keeping everyone updated throughout the process.
  • Supporting the preparation of interview materials and recruitment documentation.
  • Maintaining accurate candidate information and updating our recruitment systems.
  • Helping to ensure candidates have a positive experience when engaging with BioPhorum.

HR and People Support

  • Providing general administrative support across the employee lifecycle.
  • Supporting onboarding activities for new starters.
  • Maintaining accurate employee records and updating our HR system.
  • Preparing HR documentation and supporting day-to-day People team activities.
  • Helping with wider HR projects and initiatives, including employee engagement and internal communications.

You'll also have the opportunity to get involved in different projects, learn how the People team operates and build your understanding of the wider business.

What we're looking for

We're much more interested in your potential, attitude and approach than how much experience you already have.

You'll ideally be someone who:

  • Is a recent graduate, or has equivalent experience, and is keen to build a career in HR or recruitment.
  • Is proactive and takes initiative rather than waiting to be told what to do.
  • Is naturally organised, able to manage different priorities and has a good eye for detail.
  • Has strong communication skills and enjoys interacting with different people.
  • Is curious, asks questions and is keen to understand how things work.
  • Is confident using technology and comfortable learning new systems.
  • Takes responsibility for their work and follows things through.
  • Is positive, adaptable and happy to get involved wherever needed.

You don't need to tick every box. If you have the right attitude and are excited about developing a career in HR, we'd love to hear from you.

What will you get out of it?

This isn't just an entry-level administration role. It's an opportunity to build a strong foundation for a career in HR and Talent Acquisition.

You'll gain:

  • Hands-on experience across recruitment and the wider employee lifecycle.
  • Exposure to different areas of HR and how they support a growing international business.
  • The opportunity to work closely with experienced HR and Talent professionals.
  • Support, guidance and the chance to develop your skills and confidence.
  • Opportunities to contribute to projects and take ownership of your own responsibilities.
  • A role where you can make a genuine contribution and see the impact of your work.

Why BioPhorum?

At BioPhorum, we believe in bringing people together, sharing knowledge and making a difference. You'll be joining a collaborative team where people are encouraged to contribute ideas, take initiative and develop.

If you're looking for a role where you can learn, grow, challenge yourself and build a career in HR, this could be the perfect place to start.

Interested?

We'd love to hear from you. You don't need to have your career all figured out – just bring your enthusiasm, curiosity and willingness to learn.

title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

 

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

 

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

title: Front End Developer
description:
Job Title: Front-End Developer
Location: Fully Remote (US)
Department: Global Enrollment Marketing and Sales
Reports to: Director of Web Development
Classification: Regular, Full-time
FLSA Status: Exempt
Prepared by: Global Head of Creative
Prepared Date: 10/1/26
Salary range: $85,000â$100,000


About Edconic

Edconic is a leading player in the alternative, experiential education space. We partner with the world's largest and most well-known brands to create and run schools that capture the legacy and value of each brand. Our students get truly unique, once-in-a-lifetime experiences that help shape their future and give them the skills they need to reach their goals.

The Role

We're looking for an experienced Front-End Developer to join our web team, which owns every Edconic digital property â from our school websites to landing pages and email templates. You'll work alongside designers, IT, and MarTech to build solutions that serve real business needs while protecting each brand's unique identity.

You'll be one of two developers on the team, working directly with our lead developer. That means real ownership of your work, a genuine voice in how we build, very little process overhead, and a codebase that is actively moving toward a modern, standardized WordPress stack. We value craft: fast pages and code that the next developer can read.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain public-facing websites, micro-sites, and landing pages in collaboration with our lead developer, IT, and MarTech.
  • Work with UX/UI designers to confirm the technical feasibility of designs, then translate them into polished, responsive pages that stay true to each brand.
  • Build and maintain custom WordPress themes across both of our stacks: modern block-based builds (ACF Blocks, core blocks, block patterns, theme.json) and established classic themes built on PHP templates, Advanced Custom Fields, and Sass.
  • Collaborate with our lead developer to shape the team's coding standards, tooling, and workflow, and help migrate our existing sites toward our new modern stack.
  • Stay current on emerging web standards and bring ideas to the table where they genuinely fit.

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of front-end web development experience, with strong skills in semantic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and WordPress.
  • The ability to build a custom WordPress theme from scratch using PHP templates and Advanced Custom Fields.
  • Strong CSS skills across Sass and modern native CSS (custom properties, nesting), and solid vanilla JavaScript.
  • Comfort working in Git/GitHub with pull requests and code reviews, and with npm-based build tools and the command line.
  • A habit of writing semantic, well-structured HTML that covers accessibility basics, with an eye for reuse, cross-browser compatibility, performance, and SEO.
  • Experience building and testing HTML emails.
  • Strong UX/UI sensibilities and a desire to sweat the small stuff.
  • A proactive, self-directed working style â you can run with a project independently and prioritize across several at once.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication â you're positive, collaborative, objective, and solution-oriented.

Bonus Experience

  • Modern WordPress block development: ACF Blocks, block.json, theme.json, and block patterns.
  • Composer, Bedrock or other Roots tooling (Sage/Blade, Trellis), Vite, or CI/CD with GitHub Actions.
  • Deeper accessibility experience (WCAG, ARIA, assistive-technology testing).
  • CRM and marketing automation integration (Salesforce, Pardot/Account Engagement).
  • Multilingual WordPress sites.
  • A modern JavaScript framework such as React or Vue.
  • UX or UI design, and design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.


How We Use AI

AI-assisted development is a new and evolving part of our workflow. We use AI coding tools to speed up research, scaffolding, review, and routine work, and you're welcome to do the same.

AI is a tool here, not a substitute for expertise. You are accountable for every line of code that you ship, which means you must be able to write, review, debug, and explain production code entirely on your own. Expect to demonstrate those skills without AI assistance during the interview process.

Location, Travel & Eligibility

  • Fully remote within the United States. Occasional travel to our New York office may be required.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the US.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred (Computer Science, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, Communications, or a related field); equivalent professional experience is equally welcome.

Our Commitment

Edconic supports and embraces diversity and inclusiveness, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed here. Reasonable accommodations are available to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role and to participate in the interview process.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work for this position. They are not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills. Edconic reserves the right to modify this job description at its sole discretion.

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
ShyftOff connects independent customer service professionals with opportunities to support leading brands across industries like healthcare, financial services, insurance, retail, and technology.

As an independent agent on the ShyftOff platform, you'll have opportunities to help customers answer questions, resolve issues, and deliver exceptional service, all from the comfort of your home.

Compensation: $14–$20 per hour, depending on the program and applicable compensation structure.

 

Why Join ShyftOff?

  • Choose your own schedule: Select available shifts in 30-minute increments. Accept opportunities that fit your life, with no minimum hour commitments.
  • 100% remote: Provide customer service from home, without a commute or traditional office schedule.
  • Competitive earnings: Access opportunities with competitive, program-specific compensation rates disclosed before you commit.
  • Weekly payments: Get paid weekly for completed services, subject to program terms.
  • Multiple opportunities: Explore customer service programs across a variety of industries based on your qualifications and availability.
  • Priority Boarding: Top-performing, reliable agents receive priority access to available shifts, helping maximize their earning opportunities.
  • Work on your terms: Operate as a 1099 independent contractor with the freedom to choose which opportunities you accept.

 

Qualifications

We're looking for dependable, customer-focused independent professionals who take pride in delivering great service.

  • 3+ years of customer service experience preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities, empathy, and active listening skills.
  • Ability to fulfill accepted service commitments and meet client quality standards.
  • Comfortable navigating multiple computer systems and learning new technology.
  • Modern computer, USB headset, and reliable hard-wired internet connection (25 Mbps minimum).
  • Quiet, professional workspace suitable for customer calls.
  • Ability to complete program-specific qualifications, certifications, and onboarding requirements.

Location: Remote, United States only. Eligibility is limited to ShyftOff-approved states.

 

How to Get Started

  1. Sign up: Create your free ShyftOff account, complete your application, and submit your video interview.
  2. Explore opportunities: Review available programs, compensation rates, and qualification requirements to find the right fit.
  3. Get qualified: Complete any required program-specific certifications or onboarding.
  4. Choose your shifts: Select available 30-minute shifts that work for your schedule.
  5. Get paid weekly: Earn money by delivering great customer service.

Join 26,000+ agents who have discovered a more flexible way to work. Sign up today at https://app.shyftoff.com/r/QPFQWH

 

Independent Contractor Disclosure: ShyftOff provides opportunities for independent contractors, not traditional employment. Agents choose whether to accept available opportunities and are responsible for their own taxes, equipment, and business expenses. Program-specific certification and onboarding requirements are explained in the ShyftOff app.

description:
Purpose in Every Position

Pebl puts a world of talent at your fingertips. With our AI-powered Global Work Platformâ¢, companies can hire, pay, and manage employees in 185+ countriesâremoving risk, red tape, and guesswork from global growth. Backed by more than a decade of compliance leadership and local expertise, Pebl helps businesses move fast, stay compliant, and scale with confidence. With Pebl, companies everywhere can hire great talent anywhere.

Where Your Work Moves the Needle.

At Pebl, every team member drives our success. Joining us means more than filling a roleâyouâre accountable for results and impact. Our values guide how we operate, execute, and collaborate across borders. By putting them into action, youâll help us scale faster, compete harder, and lead the future of global work.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

Pebl is looking for a Recruiting Coordinator who will assist the People team in driving hiring across the business. The ideal candidate will support the recruiting team and hiring managers by coordinating interviews while ensuring an exceptional candidate experience. This role interacts with all levels of the company to successfully execute the recruitment process and special projects. The ideal candidate might not have any prior recruitment experience, but is looking to break into Recruiting. The person we will hire is exceptionally detail-oriented, organized, and inquisitive, and is also friendly and self-sufficient. This is a tremendous developmental opportunity for the right person.

This is a fully remote position based in Colombia.

How You'll Make an Impact:

  • Support all aspects of the recruiting process, working directly with recruiters, candidates and hiring managers, owning the coordination & logistics of complicated, multi-step interviews.

  • Ensure that every candidate we have an interaction with is documented and scheduled correctly in our recruiting systems.

  • Ensure every candidate interaction is customer-focused and that each candidate has a great experience interviewing and communicating with the Pebl team.

  • Work with the recruiting team to help source prospective candidates for hard-to-fill searches.

Let's Connect If You:

title: Freelance Software Tester | Remote in Italy
description:
Hi there! We're Testlio, a global software testing company that has been helping businesses improve their digital products since 2012.
We work with companies around the world to test websites, mobile apps, and online payment systems. Our freelance community helps identify issues and make sure these products work as expected for real customers.
Learn more about us at www.testlio.com.

About This Opportunity

We're looking for people in Italy, Belgium, and Germany to help us test how local payment methods work when paying for advertising on Facebook and Instagram through Meta Ads Manager.

Requirements:

  • Location & Payment Method:
    • Italy: Satispay account.
    • Belgium: Wero activated with a Belgian bank account.
    • Germany: Wero activated with a German bank account.
  • Have access to Meta Ads Manager, or be willing to create an account.
  • Have an iOS/Android device or a computer with an updated browser, plus a smartphone with the required payment app.
  • Comfortable following instructions and submitting feedback in English.
  • Available to start ASAP and complete testing by November 16, 2026.
  • Duration: Approximately 1.5 hours.
  • Compensation: Paid hourly testing assignment.

Don't have Satispay or Wero yet? You can still apply if you're willing and eligible to set it up before testing.

What You'll Do:

  • Follow step-by-step instructions from our testing team.
  • Add a local payment method to Meta Ads Manager.
  • Complete a small advertising payment of approximately €5.
  • Check whether the payment goes through successfully.
  • Report any errors or unexpected behavior, including screenshots when needed.

Why do we need local testers?
Online payment methods can work differently depending on the country, bank, and device. That's why companies need local people to help check that payments are processed correctly.
Your role is to follow simple instructions, complete a small authorized transaction, and tell us whether everything worked as expected.
No previous software testing experience is required!

Privacy & Security

We take the protection of personal and financial information seriously.
You'll receive instructions for the assigned testing activities. Never share passwords, full card numbers, or sensitive banking information in your reports.

If your profile matches the project requirements, our team will reach out with the next steps.

You’ll solve real business problems for senior stakeholders by breaking into net new enterprise accounts and expanding adoption within existing customers, using a consultative sales approach to connect their priorities with GitLab’s DevSecOps and AI capabilities.

You’ll lead full-cycle, complex deals, collaborate closely with pre- and post-sales teams and strategic channel partners, and act as the voice of your customers by sharing their feedback and product ideas through GitLab’s public issue tracker.

In your first year, you’ll be expected to build and execute focused account plans, establish a healthy, qualified pipeline, and drive successful evaluations and rollouts that set the foundation for long-term growth across your territory.

What you’ll do

  • Own a portfolio of strategic and large enterprise accounts in Spain, driving both new customer acquisition and expansion within existing customers.

  • Develop and execute focused account plans that connect customer priorities with GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform and GitLab Duo capabilities.

  • Work with Marketing to shape and support account-based and regional campaigns tailored to priority accounts and key buying centers in your territory.

What you’ll bring

  • Background selling software, developer tools, or related technology solutions to senior business and technical stakeholders in enterprise organisations.
  • Skill in building and executing structured account plans, managing pipeline and forecast data, and coordinating cross-functional resources across pre-sales, post-sales, support, and channel partners.

title: Freelance Software Tester | Remote in Germany
description:
Hi there! We're Testlio, a global software testing company that has been helping businesses improve their digital products since 2012.
We work with companies around the world to test websites, mobile apps, and online payment systems. Our freelance community helps identify issues and make sure these products work as expected for real customers.
Learn more about us at www.testlio.com.

About This Opportunity

We're looking for people in Italy, Belgium, and Germany to help us test how local payment methods work when paying for advertising on Facebook and Instagram through Meta Ads Manager.

Requirements:

  • Location & Payment Method:
    • Italy: Satispay account.
    • Belgium: Wero activated with a Belgian bank account.
    • Germany: Wero activated with a German bank account.
  • Have access to Meta Ads Manager, or be willing to create an account.
  • Have an iOS/Android device or a computer with an updated browser, plus a smartphone with the required payment app.
  • Comfortable following instructions and submitting feedback in English.
  • Available to start ASAP and complete testing by November 16, 2026.
  • Duration: Approximately 1.5 hours.
  • Compensation: Paid hourly testing assignment.

Don't have Satispay or Wero yet? You can still apply if you're willing and eligible to set it up before testing.

What You'll Do:

  • Follow step-by-step instructions from our testing team.
  • Add a local payment method to Meta Ads Manager.
  • Complete a small advertising payment of approximately €5.
  • Check whether the payment goes through successfully.
  • Report any errors or unexpected behavior, including screenshots when needed.

Why do we need local testers?
Online payment methods can work differently depending on the country, bank, and device. That's why companies need local people to help check that payments are processed correctly.
Your role is to follow simple instructions, complete a small authorized transaction, and tell us whether everything worked as expected.
No previous software testing experience is required!

Privacy & Security

We take the protection of personal and financial information seriously.
You'll receive instructions for the assigned testing activities. Never share passwords, full card numbers, or sensitive banking information in your reports.

If your profile matches the project requirements, our team will reach out with the next steps.
Official recruitment emails will come from a @testlio.com email address, so please keep an eye on your inbox!

title: Founding Sales Development Representative (Southern Europe)
description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send thousands of payouts to anyone, anywhere, for free. We're trusted by 20,000 organizations like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way to deliver gift cards and money to millions of recipients worldwide.

Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. Check out our ratings on G2.

Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. We're a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life. The team agrees– our employee NPS is in the high 80s.

About the role

We’re looking for a Founding European SDR to help launch and scale Tremendous’ outbound motion internationally. As one of our first international SDR hires, you’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and booking meetings with high-potential prospects, while helping define how we sell into new European markets.

You will partner closely with Account Executives to generate meetings and act as the first point of contact for prospective customers. This role requires strong outbound execution across email, phone, social, events, and field marketing, with meaningful ownership over account development and early market strategy.

As a founding hire, you will have the opportunity to shape messaging, process, and best practices for international sales while directly impacting pipeline, revenue growth, and Tremendous’ expansion internationally.

What you'll do

  • Work primarily to bring in new deals through outbound prospecting for the Southern European Market

  • Own your pipeline through cold calling first. The phone is your primary weapon; you'll be expected to make 80+ cold calls per day, book meetings over the phone, and treat every unanswered call as the next opportunity to dial again. Email and LinkedIn support your outreach; they don't replace it

  • Collaborate with Account Executives, as well as members of our Marketing, Strategy, and RevOps teams, to develop new strategies to build our sales pipeline and grow our business

  • Use prospecting tools to research accounts, identify key contacts and craft targeted messaging

  • Learn our technology and effectively communicate our value proposition. Work to understand their goals and challenges to better understand how we can help.

What you'll bring

  • You're fluent in English as well as Spanish and Italian to engage prospects across southern Europe.

  • You pick up the phone before you open email. Cold calling isn't something you tolerate - it's how you start your day, every day, without being told to.

  • Demonstrated history of consistently exceeding personal and professional goals, with a strong commitment to excellence in all endeavors

  • Curious, lifelong learner mindset with a passion for continuous improvement, staying updated on industry trends and best practices, and showing enthusiasm for applying newly acquired knowledge to improve job performance

  • Customer-obsessed sales approach, demonstrating a deep commitment to understanding and addressing the unique needs of our clients

  • Independent. We all work together to solve tough problems here at Tremendous, but taking pride in experimenting and finding your own answers is the best way to learn.

  • Collaborative. When our SDRs uncover new trends and tactics that work to set meetings, they share them with their teammates so everyone can benefit.

  • Ambitious. Ambition isn't a dirty word at Tremendous. We're a team of achievers collaborating on a fast-growing product and that means personal growth in both role and responsibility as well as tons of personal upside for you.

What's cool about the role

  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary for this role: €39k - €45k. OTE: €56k - €62k.

  • Fully remote within Spain

  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

title: Music & Sound Annotation Expert
description:
Role Title: Music & Sound Annotation Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Music & Sound Annotation Experts to contribute to a customer's project at the forefront of music and audio technology.

Your ears are the ground truth. You'll listen to short field recordings and document exactly what's audible — instruments, tempo, key, background sounds, crowd reactions — through a structured web platform built for this project. Later phases involve grading AI model answers against what you actually heard.

What you'll do

  1. Listen to 30–90 second field recordings (headphones, your own quiet workspace) and complete structured annotations: which instruments are present, tempo and key, timestamps of background events (traffic, sirens, applause), scene details
  2. Compare paired recordings of the same song captured at different locations and judge what stayed the same and what changed
  3. In later phases: review AI model descriptions of clips and mark what's correct, wrong, or invented, with a brief written explanation
  4. Attend a paid onboarding/calibration session and a short weekly sync

Who we're looking for (any of these backgrounds)

  1. Working or gigging musicians, session players, producers, or mixing engineers
  2. Music educators, ear-training instructors, band/choir directors, conservatory students or graduates
  3. Location sound recordists, sound designers, foley artists, or podcast/documentary audio editors

Requirements

  1. 3+ years of hands-on music or audio experience
  2. Strong analytical listening: you can pick individual instruments out of a busy, noisy, real-world mix — not just studio recordings
  3. Can identify tempo (within a few BPM) and musical key (relative pitch with a reference is fine)
  4. Comfortable with detail-oriented, repetitive annotation work in a web platform — dropdowns, timestamps, short structured notes
  5. Clear written English for brief, evidence-based notes (e.g., "accordion enters around 0:12")
  6. Quality headphones, quiet workspace, reliable internet
  7. Available 20–25 hrs/week for the engagement window

title: Remote Customer Service Representative - Independent Contractor
description:
Company Description

ShyftOff is a flexible work platform that connects independent customer service professionals with leading brands across the U.S. With 26,000+ agents and growing, we're changing how people work by giving them more freedom, flexibility, and control over their earning potential.

Our platform offers 100% remote customer service opportunities, flexible scheduling in 30-minute increments, competitive compensation, and weekly payments. Whether you're looking for supplemental income or more consistent opportunities, ShyftOff makes it easy to find work that fits your life.

Work from home. Choose your hours. Earn on your terms.

Opportunity Description

ShyftOff connects independent customer service professionals with opportunities to support leading brands across industries like healthcare, financial services, insurance, retail, and technology.

As an independent agent on the ShyftOff platform, you'll have opportunities to help customers answer questions, resolve issues, and deliver exceptional service, all from the comfort of your home.

Compensation: $14–$20 per hour, depending on the program and applicable compensation structure.

Why Join ShyftOff?

  • Choose your own schedule: Select available shifts in 30-minute increments. Accept opportunities that fit your life, with no minimum hour commitments.
  • 100% remote: Provide customer service from home, without a commute or traditional office schedule.
  • Competitive earnings: Access opportunities with competitive, program-specific compensation rates disclosed before you commit.
  • Weekly payments: Get paid weekly for completed services, subject to program terms.
  • Multiple opportunities: Explore customer service programs across a variety of industries based on your qualifications and availability.
  • Priority Boarding: Top-performing, reliable agents receive priority access to available shifts, helping maximize their earning opportunities.
  • Work on your terms: Operate as a 1099 independent contractor with the freedom to choose which opportunities you accept.

Qualifications

We're looking for dependable, customer-focused independent professionals who take pride in delivering great service.

  • 3+ years of customer service experience preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities, empathy, and active listening skills.
  • Ability to fulfill accepted service commitments and meet client quality standards.
  • Comfortable navigating multiple computer systems and learning new technology.
  • Modern computer, USB headset, and reliable hard-wired internet connection (25 Mbps minimum).
  • Quiet, professional workspace suitable for customer calls.
  • Ability to complete program-specific qualifications, certifications, and onboarding requirements.

Location: Remote, United States only. Eligibility is limited to ShyftOff-approved states.

How to Get Started

  1. Sign up: Create your free ShyftOff account, complete your application, and submit your video interview.
  2. Explore opportunities: Review available programs, compensation rates, and qualification requirements to find the right fit.
  3. Get qualified: Complete any required program-specific certifications or onboarding.
  4. Choose your shifts: Select available 30-minute shifts that work for your schedule.
  5. Get paid weekly: Earn money by delivering great customer service.

Ready to Get Started?

Join 26,000+ agents who have discovered a more flexible way to work.

Your schedule. Your opportunities. Your success.

Sign up today at https://app.shyftoff.com/r/QPFQWH

Independent Contractor Disclosure: ShyftOff provides opportunities for independent contractors, not traditional employment. Agents choose whether to accept available opportunities and are responsible for their own taxes, equipment, and business expenses. Compensation, qualifications, and available hours vary by program and are not guaranteed. There is no fee to join ShyftOff. When you opt into a specific client program, you pay for that program's non-refundable background check ($40 for most programs; $199 for the Financial Services program). Program-specific certification and onboarding requirements are explained in the ShyftOff app.
